name: Ashramavasika Parva

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
prApya rAjyaM mahAbhAgAH pANDavA me pitAmahAH |
kathamAsanmahArAje dhRRitarAShTre mahAtmani
shlokas.2:
sa hi rAjA hatAmAtyo hataputro nirAshrayaH |
kathamAsIddhataishvaryo gAndhArI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.3:
kiyantaM chaiva kAlaM te pitaro mama pUrvakAH |
sthitA rAjye mahAtmAnastanme vyAkhyAtumarhasi
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
prApya rAjyaM mahAtmAnaH pANDavA hatashatravaH |
dhRRitarAShTraM puraskRRitya pRRithivIM paryapAlayan
shlokas.5:
dhRRitarAShTramupAtiShThadviduraH sa~njayastathA |
yuyutsushchApi medhAvI vaishyAputraH sa kauravaH
shlokas.6:
pANDavAH sarvakAryANi sampRRichChanti sma taM nRRipam |
chakrustenAbhyanuj~nAtA varShANi dasha pa~ncha cha
shlokas.7:
sadA hi gatvA te vIrAH paryupAsanta taM nRRipam |
pAdAbhivandanaM kRRitvA dharmarAjamate sthitAH
te mUrdhni samupAghrAtAH sarvakAryANi chakrire
shlokas.8:
kuntibhojasutA chaiva gAndhArImanvavartata |
draupadI cha subhadrA cha yAshchAnyAH pANDavastriyaH
samAM vRRittimavartanta tayoH shvashrvoryathAvidhi
shlokas.9:
shayanAni mahArhANi vAsA.nsyAbharaNAni cha |
rAjArhANi cha sarvANi bhakShyabhojyAnyanekashaH
yudhiShThiro mahArAja dhRRitarAShTre.abhyupAharat
shlokas.10:
tathaiva kuntI gAndhAryAM guruvRRittimavartata |
viduraH sa~njayashchaiva yuyutsushchaiva kauravaH
upAsate sma taM vRRiddhaM hataputraM janAdhipam
shlokas.11:
syAlo droNasya yashchaiko dayito brAhmaNo mahAn |
sa cha tasminmaheShvAsaH kRRipaH samabhavattadA
shlokas.12:
vyAsashcha bhagavAnnityaM vAsaM chakre nRRipeNa ha |
kathAH kurvanpurANarShirdevarShinRRiparakShasAm
shlokas.13:
dharmayuktAni kAryANi vyavahArAnvitAni cha |
dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nAto vidurastAnyakArayat
shlokas.14:
sAmantebhyaH priyANyasya kAryANi sugurUNyapi |
prApyante.arthaiH sulaghubhiH prabhAvAdvidurasya vai
shlokas.15:
akarodbandhamokShA.nshcha vadhyAnAM mokShaNaM tathA |
na cha dharmAtmajo rAjA kadAchitki~nchidabravIt
shlokas.16:
vihArayAtrAsu punaH kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
sarvAnkAmAnmahAtejAH pradadAvambikAsute
shlokas.17:
ArAlikAH sUpakArA rAgakhANDavikAstathA |
upAtiShThanta rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM yathA purA
shlokas.18:
vAsA.nsi cha mahArhANi mAlyAni vividhAni cha |
upAjahruryathAnyAyaM dhRRitarAShTrasya pANDavAH
shlokas.19:
maireyaM madhu mA.nsAni pAnakAni laghUni cha |
chitrAnbhakShyavikArA.nshcha chakrurasya yathA purA
shlokas.20:
ye chApi pRRithivIpAlAH samAjagmuH samantataH |
upAtiShThanta te sarve kauravendraM yathA purA
shlokas.21:
kuntI cha draupadI chaiva sAtvatI chaiva bhAminI |
ulUpI nAgakanyA cha devI chitrA~NgadA tathA
shlokas.22:
dhRRiShTaketoshcha bhaginI jarAsandhasya chAtmajA |
ki~NkarAH smopatiShThanti sarvAH subalajAM tathA
shlokas.23:
yathA putraviyukto.ayaM na ki~nchidduHkhamApnuyAt |
iti rAjAnvashAdbhrAtR^Innityameva yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.24:
evaM te dharmarAjasya shrutvA vachanamarthavat |
savisheShamavartanta bhImamekaM vinA tadA
shlokas.25:
na hi tattasya vIrasya hRRidayAdapasarpati |
dhRRitarAShTrasya durbuddheryadvRRittaM dyUtakAritam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sampUjito rAjA pANDavairambikAsutaH |
vijahAra yathApUrvamRRiShibhiH paryupAsitaH
shlokas.2:
brahmadeyAgrahArA.nshcha pradadau sa kurUdvahaH |
tachcha kuntIsuto rAjA sarvamevAnvamodata
shlokas.3:
AnRRisha.nsyaparo rAjA prIyamANo yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha sa tadA bhrAtR^InamAtyA.nshcha mahIpatiH
shlokas.4:
mayA chaiva bhavadbhishcha mAnya eSha narAdhipaH |
nideshe dhRRitarAShTrasya yaH sthAsyati sa me suhRRit
viparItashcha me shatrurnirasyashcha bhavennaraH
shlokas.5:
paridRRiShTeShu chAhaHsu putrANAM shrAddhakarmaNi |
dadAtu rAjA sarveShAM yAvadasya chikIrShitam
shlokas.6:
tataH sa rAjA kauravyo dhRRitarAShTro mahAmanAH |
brAhmaNebhyo mahArhebhyo dadau vittAnyanekashaH
shlokas.7:
dharmarAjashcha bhImashcha savyasAchI yamAvapi |
tatsarvamanvavartanta dhRRitarAShTravyapekShayA
shlokas.8:
kathaM nu rAjA vRRiddhaH sanputrashokasamAhataH |
shokamasmatkRRitaM prApya na mriyeteti chintyate
shlokas.9:
yAvaddhi kurumukhyasya jIvatputrasya vai sukham |
babhUva tadavApnotu bhogA.nshcheti vyavasthitAH
shlokas.10:
tataste sahitAH sarve bhrAtaraH pa~ncha pANDavAH |
tathAshIlAH samAtasthurdhRRitarAShTrasya shAsane
shlokas.11:
dhRRitarAShTrashcha tAnvIrAnvinItAnvinaye sthitAn |
shiShyavRRittau sthitAnnityaM guruvatparyapashyata
shlokas.12:
gAndhArI chaiva putrANAM vividhaiH shrAddhakarmabhiH |
AnRRiNyamagamatkAmAnviprebhyaH pratipAdya vai
shlokas.13:
evaM dharmabhRRitAM shreShTho dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahito dhImAnpUjayAmAsa taM nRRipam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa rAjA sumahAtejA vRRiddhaH kurukulodvahaH |
nApashyata tadA ki~nchidapriyaM pANDunandane
shlokas.2:
vartamAneShu sadvRRittiM pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
prItimAnabhavadrAjA dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH
shlokas.3:
saubaleyI cha gAndhArI putrashokamapAsya tam |
sadaiva prItimatyAsIttanayeShu nijeShviva
shlokas.4:
priyANyeva tu kauravyo nApriyANi kurUdvaha |
vaichitravIrye nRRipatau samAcharati nityadA
shlokas.5:
yadyadbrUte cha ki~nchitsa dhRRitarAShTro narAdhipaH |
guru vA laghu vA kAryaM gAndhArI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.6:
tatsa rAjA mahArAja pANDavAnAM dhurandharaH |
pUjayitvA vachastattadakArShItparavIrahA
shlokas.7:
tena tasyAbhavatprIto vRRittena sa narAdhipaH |
anvatapyachcha sa.nsmRRitya putraM mandamachetasam
shlokas.8:
sadA cha prAtarutthAya kRRitajapyaH shuchirnRRipaH |
AshAste pANDuputrANAM samareShvaparAjayam
shlokas.9:
brAhmaNAnvAchayitvA cha hutvA chaiva hutAshanam |
AyuShyaM pANDuputrANAmAshAste sa narAdhipaH
shlokas.10:
na tAM prItiM parAmApa putrebhyaH sa mahIpatiH |
yAM prItiM pANDuputrebhyaH samavApa tadA nRRipaH
shlokas.11:
brAhmaNAnAM cha vRRiddhAnAM kShatriyANAM cha bhArata |
tathA viTshUdrasa~NghAnAmabhavatsupriyastadA
shlokas.12:
yachcha ki~nchitpurA pApaM dhRRitarAShTrasutaiH kRRitam |
akRRitvA hRRidi tadrAjA taM nRRipaM so.anvavartata
shlokas.13:
yashcha kashchinnaraH ki~nchidapriyaM chAmbikAsute |
kurute dveShyatAmeti sa kaunteyasya dhImataH
shlokas.14:
na rAj~no dhRRitarAShTrasya na cha duryodhanasya vai |
uvAcha duShkRRitaM ki~nchidyudhiShThirabhayAnnaraH
shlokas.15:
dhRRityA tuShTo narendrasya gAndhArI vidurastathA |
shauchena chAjAtashatrorna tu bhImasya shatruhan
shlokas.16:
anvavartata bhImo.api niShTanandharmajaM nRRipam |
dhRRitarAShTraM cha samprekShya sadA bhavati durmanAH
shlokas.17:
rAjAnamanuvartantaM dharmaputraM mahAmatim |
anvavartata kauravyo hRRidayena parA~NmukhaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
yudhiShThirasya nRRipaterduryodhanapitustathA |
nAntaraM dadRRishU rAjanpuruShAH praNayaM prati
shlokas.2:
yadA tu kauravo rAjA putraM sasmAra bAlisham |
tadA bhImaM hRRidA rAjannapadhyAti sa pArthivaH
shlokas.3:
tathaiva bhImaseno.api dhRRitarAShTraM janAdhipam |
nAmarShayata rAjendra sadaivAtuShTavaddhRRidA
shlokas.4:
aprakAshAnyapriyANi chakArAsya vRRikodaraH |
Aj~nAM pratyaharachchApi kRRitakaiH puruShaiH sadA
shlokas.5:
atha bhImaH suhRRinmadhye bAhushabdaM tathAkarot |
sa.nshrave dhRRitarAShTrasya gAndhAryAshchApyamarShaNaH
shlokas.6:
smRRitvA duryodhanaM shatruM karNaduHshAsanAvapi |
provAchAtha susa.nrabdho bhImaH sa paruShaM vachaH
shlokas.7:
andhasya nRRipateH putrA mayA parighabAhunA |
nItA lokamamuM sarve nAnAshastrAttajIvitAH
shlokas.8:
imau tau parighaprakhyau bhujau mama durAsadau |
yayorantaramAsAdya dhArtarAShTrAH kShayaM gatAH
shlokas.9:
tAvimau chandanenAktau vandanIyau cha me bhujau |
yAbhyAM duryodhano nItaH kShayaM sasutabAndhavaH
shlokas.10:
etAshchAnyAshcha vividhAH shalyabhUtA janAdhipaH |
vRRikodarasya tA vAchaH shrutvA nirvedamAgamat
shlokas.11:
sA cha buddhimatI devI kAlaparyAyavedinI |
gAndhArI sarvadharmaj~nA tAnyalIkAni shushruve
shlokas.12:
tataH pa~nchadashe varShe samatIte narAdhipaH |
rAjA nirvedamApede bhImavAgbANapIDitaH
shlokas.13:
nAnvabudhyata tadrAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
shvetAshvo vAtha kuntI vA draupadI vA yashasvinI
shlokas.14:
mAdrIputrau cha bhImasya chittaj~nAvanvamodatAm |
rAj~nastu chittaM rakShantau nochatuH ki~nchidapriyam
shlokas.15:
tataH samAnayAmAsa dhRRitarAShTraH suhRRijjanam |
bAShpasa.ndigdhamatyarthamidamAha vacho bhRRisham

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
viditaM bhavatAmetadyathA vRRittaH kurukShayaH |
mamAparAdhAttatsarvamiti j~neyaM tu kauravAH
shlokas.2:
yo.ahaM duShTamatiM mUDhaM j~nAtInAM bhayavardhanam |
duryodhanaM kauravANAmAdhipatye.abhyaShechayam
shlokas.3:
yachchAhaM vAsudevasya vAkyaM nAshrauShamarthavat |
vadhyatAM sAdhvayaM pApaH sAmAtya iti durmatiH
shlokas.4:
putrasnehAbhibhUtashcha hitamukto manIShibhiH |
vidureNAtha bhIShmeNa droNena cha kRRipeNa cha
shlokas.5:
pade pade bhagavatA vyAsena cha mahAtmanA |
sa~njayenAtha gAndhAryA tadidaM tapyate.adya mAm
shlokas.6:
yachchAhaM pANDuputreNa guNavatsu mahAtmasu |
na dattavA~nshriyaM dIptAM pitRRipaitAmahImimAm
shlokas.7:
vinAshaM pashyamAno hi sarvarAj~nAM gadAgrajaH |
etachChreyaH sa paramamamanyata janArdanaH
shlokas.8:
so.ahametAnyalIkAni nivRRittAnyAtmanaH sadA |
hRRidaye shalyabhUtAni dhArayAmi sahasrashaH
shlokas.9:
visheShatastu dahyAmi varShaM pa~nchadashaM hi vai |
asya pApasya shuddhyarthaM niyato.asmi sudurmatiH
shlokas.10:
chaturthe niyate kAle kadAchidapi chAShTame |
tRRiShNAvinayanaM bhu~nje gAndhArI veda tanmama
shlokas.11:
karotyAhAramiti mAM sarvaH parijanaH sadA |
yudhiShThirabhayAdvetti bhRRishaM tapyati pANDavaH
shlokas.12:
bhUmau shaye japyaparo darbheShvajinasa.nvRRitaH |
niyamavyapadeshena gAndhArI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.13:
hataM putrashataM shUraM sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinam |
nAnutapyAmi tachchAhaM kShatradharmaM hi taM viduH
ityuktvA dharmarAjAnamabhyabhAShata kauravaH
shlokas.14:
bhadraM te yAdavImAtarvAkyaM chedaM nibodha me |
sukhamasmyuShitaH putra tvayA suparipAlitaH
shlokas.15:
mahAdAnAni dattAni shrAddhAni cha punaH punaH |
prakRRiShTaM me vayaH putra puNyaM chIrNaM yathAbalam
gAndhArI hataputreyaM dhairyeNodIkShate cha mAm
shlokas.16:
draupadyA hyapakartArastava chaishvaryahAriNaH |
samatItA nRRisha.nsAste dharmeNa nihatA yudhi
shlokas.17:
na teShu pratikartavyaM pashyAmi kurunandana |
sarve shastrajitA.NllokAngatAste.abhimukhaM hatAH
shlokas.18:
Atmanastu hitaM mukhyaM pratikartavyamadya me |
gAndhAryAshchaiva rAjendra tadanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.19:
tvaM hi dharmabhRRitAM shreShThaH satataM dharmavatsalaH |
rAjA guruH prANabhRRitAM tasmAdetadbravImyaham
shlokas.20:
anuj~nAtastvayA vIra sa.nshrayeyaM vanAnyaham |
chIravalkalabhRRidrAjangAndhAryA sahito.anayA
tavAshiShaH prayu~njAno bhaviShyAmi vanecharaH
shlokas.21:
uchitaM naH kule tAta sarveShAM bharatarShabha |
putreShvaishvaryamAdhAya vayaso.ante vanaM nRRipa
shlokas.22:
tatrAhaM vAyubhakSho vA nirAhAro.api vA vasan |
patnyA sahAnayA vIra chariShyAmi tapaH param
shlokas.23:
tvaM chApi phalabhAktAta tapasaH pArthivo hyasi |
phalabhAjo hi rAjAnaH kalyANasyetarasya vA

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
na mAM prINayate rAjyaM tvayyevaM duHkhite nRRipa |
dhi~NmAmastu sudurbuddhiM rAjyasaktaM pramAdinam
shlokas.2:
yo.ahaM bhavantaM duHkhArtamupavAsakRRishaM nRRipa |
yatAhAraM kShitishayaM nAvindaM bhrAtRRibhiH saha
shlokas.3:
aho.asmi va~nchito mUDho bhavatA gUDhabuddhinA |
vishvAsayitvA pUrvaM mAM yadidaM duHkhamashnuthAH
shlokas.4:
kiM me rAjyena bhogairvA kiM yaj~naiH kiM sukhena vA |
yasya me tvaM mahIpAla duHkhAnyetAnyavAptavAn
shlokas.5:
pIDitaM chApi jAnAmi rAjyamAtmAnameva cha |
anena vachasA tubhyaM duHkhitasya janeshvara
shlokas.6:
bhavAnpitA bhavAnmAtA bhavAnnaH paramo guruH |
bhavatA viprahINA hi kva nu tiShThAmahe vayam
shlokas.7:
auraso bhavataH putro yuyutsurnRRipasattama |
astu rAjA mahArAja yaM chAnyaM manyate bhavAn
shlokas.8:
ahaM vanaM gamiShyAmi bhavAnrAjyaM prashAstvidam |
na mAmayashasA dagdhaM bhUyastvaM dagdhumarhasi
shlokas.9:
nAhaM rAjA bhavAnrAjA bhavatA paravAnaham |
kathaM guruM tvAM dharmaj~namanuj~nAtumihotsahe
shlokas.10:
na manyurhRRidi naH kashchidduryodhanakRRite.anagha |
bhavitavyaM tathA taddhi vayaM te chaiva mohitAH
shlokas.11:
vayaM hi putrA bhavato yathA duryodhanAdayaH |
gAndhArI chaiva kuntI cha nirvisheShe mate mama
shlokas.12:
sa mAM tvaM yadi rAjendra parityajya gamiShyasi |
pRRiShThatastvAnuyAsyAmi satyenAtmAnamAlabhe
shlokas.13:
iyaM hi vasusampUrNA mahI sAgaramekhalA |
bhavatA viprahINasya na me prItikarI bhavet
shlokas.14:
bhavadIyamidaM sarvaM shirasA tvAM prasAdaye |
tvadadhInAH sma rAjendra vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.15:
bhavitavyamanuprAptaM manye tvAM tajjanAdhipa |
diShTyA shushrUShamANastvAM mokShyAmi manaso jvaram
shlokas.16:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
tApasye me manastAta vartate kurunandana |
uchitaM hi kule.asmAkamaraNyagamanaM prabho
shlokas.17:
chiramasmyuShitaH putra chiraM shushrUShitastvayA |
vRRiddhaM mAmabhyanuj~nAtuM tvamarhasi janAdhipa
shlokas.18:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA dharmarAjAnaM vepamAnaH kRRitA~njalim |
uvAcha vachanaM rAjA dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH
shlokas.19:
sa~njayaM cha mahAmAtraM kRRipaM chApi mahAratham |
anunetumihechChAmi bhavadbhiH pRRithivIpatim
shlokas.20:
glAyate me mano hIdaM mukhaM cha parishuShyati |
vayasA cha prakRRiShTena vAgvyAyAmena chaiva hi
shlokas.21:
ityuktvA sa tu dharmAtmA vRRiddho rAjA kurUdvahaH |
gAndhArIM shishriye dhImAnsahasaiva gatAsuvat
shlokas.22:
taM tu dRRiShTvA tathAsInaM nishcheShTaM kurupArthivam |
ArtiM rAjA yayau tUrNaM kaunteyaH paravIrahA
shlokas.23:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
yasya nAgasahasreNa dashasa~Nkhyena vai balam |
so.ayaM nArImupAshritya shete rAjA gatAsuvat
shlokas.24:
AyasI pratimA yena bhImasenasya vai purA |
chUrNIkRRitA balavatA sa balArthI shritaH striyam
shlokas.25:
dhigastu mAmadharmaj~naM dhigbuddhiM dhikcha me shrutam |
yatkRRite pRRithivIpAlaH shete.ayamatathochitaH
shlokas.26:
ahamapyupavatsyAmi yathaivAyaM gururmama |
yadi rAjA na bhu~Nkte.ayaM gAndhArI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.27:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato.asya pANinA rAjA jalashItena pANDavaH |
uro mukhaM cha shanakaiH paryamArjata dharmavit
shlokas.28:
tena ratnauShadhimatA puNyena cha sugandhinA |
pANisparshena rAj~nastu rAjA sa~nj~nAmavApa ha

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
spRRisha mAM pANinA bhUyaH pariShvaja cha pANDava |
jIvAmIva hi sa.nsparshAttava rAjIvalochana
shlokas.2:
mUrdhAnaM cha tavAghrAtumichChAmi manujAdhipa |
pANibhyAM cha parispraShTuM prANA hi na jahurmama
shlokas.3:
aShTamo hyadya kAlo.ayamAhArasya kRRitasya me |
yenAhaM kurushArdUla na shaknomi vicheShTitum
shlokas.4:
vyAyAmashchAyamatyarthaM kRRitastvAmabhiyAchatA |
tato glAnamanAstAta naShTasa~nj~na ivAbhavam
shlokas.5:
tavAmRRitasamasparshaM hastasparshamimaM vibho |
labdhvA sa~njIvito.asmIti manye kurukulodvaha
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu kaunteyaH pitrA jyeShThena bhArata |
pasparsha sarvagAtreShu sauhArdAttaM shanaistadA
shlokas.7:
upalabhya tataH prANAndhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH |
bAhubhyAM sampariShvajya mUrdhnyAjighrata pANDavam
shlokas.8:
vidurAdayashcha te sarve rurudurduHkhitA bhRRisham |
atiduHkhAchcha rAjAnaM nochuH ki~nchana pANDavAH
shlokas.9:
gAndhArI tveva dharmaj~nA manasodvahatI bhRRisham |
duHkhAnyavArayadrAjanmaivamityeva chAbravIt
shlokas.10:
itarAstu striyaH sarvAH kuntyA saha suduHkhitAH |
netrairAgatavikledaiH parivArya sthitAbhavan
shlokas.11:
athAbravItpunarvAkyaM dhRRitarAShTro yudhiShThiram |
anujAnIhi mAM rAja.nstApasye bharatarShabha
shlokas.12:
glAyate me manastAta bhUyo bhUyaH prajalpataH |
na mAmataH paraM putra parikleShTumihArhasi
shlokas.13:
tasmi.nstu kauravendre taM tathA bruvati pANDavam |
sarveShAmavarodhAnAmArtanAdo mahAnabhUt
shlokas.14:
dRRiShTvA kRRishaM vivarNaM cha rAjAnamatathochitam |
upavAsaparishrAntaM tvagasthiparivAritam
shlokas.15:
dharmaputraH sa pitaraM pariShvajya mahAbhujaH |
shokajaM bAShpamutsRRijya punarvachanamabravIt
shlokas.16:
na kAmaye narashreShTha jIvitaM pRRithivIM tathA |
yathA tava priyaM rAja.nshchikIrShAmi parantapa
shlokas.17:
yadi tvahamanugrAhyo bhavato dayito.api vA |
kriyatAM tAvadAhArastato vetsyAmahe vayam
shlokas.18:
tato.abravInmahAtejA dharmaputraM sa pArthivaH |
anuj~nAtastvayA putra bhu~njIyAmiti kAmaye
shlokas.19:
iti bruvati rAjendre dhRRitarAShTre yudhiShThiram |
RRiShiH satyavatIputro vyAso.abhyetya vacho.abravIt

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
yudhiShThira mahAbAho yadAha kurunandanaH |
dhRRitarAShTro mahAtmA tvAM tatkuruShvAvichArayan
shlokas.2:
ayaM hi vRRiddho nRRipatirhataputro visheShataH |
nedaM kRRichChraM chirataraM sahediti matirmama
shlokas.3:
gAndhArI cha mahAbhAgA prAj~nA karuNavedinI |
putrashokaM mahArAja dhairyeNodvahate bhRRisham
shlokas.4:
ahamapyetadeva tvAM bravImi kuru me vachaH |
anuj~nAM labhatAM rAjA mA vRRitheha mariShyati
shlokas.5:
rAjarShINAM purANAnAmanuyAtu gatiM nRRipaH |
rAjarShINAM hi sarveShAmante vanamupAshrayaH
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktaH sa tadA rAjA vyAsenAdbhutakarmaNA |
pratyuvAcha mahAtejA dharmarAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.7:
bhagavAneva no mAnyo bhagavAneva no guruH |
bhagavAnasya rAjyasya kulasya cha parAyaNam
shlokas.8:
ahaM tu putro bhagavAnpitA rAjA gurushcha me |
nideshavartI cha pituH putro bhavati dharmataH
shlokas.9:
ityuktaH sa tu taM prAha vyAso dharmabhRRitAM varaH |
yudhiShThiraM mahAtejAH punareva vishAM pate
shlokas.10:
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi bhArata |
rAjAyaM vRRiddhatAM prAptaH pramANe parame sthitaH
shlokas.11:
so.ayaM mayAbhyanuj~nAtastvayA cha pRRithivIpate |
karotu svamabhiprAyaM mAsya vighnakaro bhava
shlokas.12:
eSha eva paro dharmo rAjarShINAM yudhiShThira |
samare vA bhavenmRRityurvane vA vidhipUrvakam
shlokas.13:
pitrA tu tava rAjendra pANDunA pRRithivIkShitA |
shiShyabhUtena rAjAyaM guruvatparyupAsitaH
shlokas.14:
kratubhirdakShiNAvadbhirannaparvatashobhitaiH |
mahadbhiriShTaM bhogAshcha bhuktAH putrAshcha pAlitAH
shlokas.15:
putrasa.nsthaM cha vipulaM rAjyaM viproShite tvayi |
trayodashasamA bhuktaM dattaM cha vividhaM vasu
shlokas.16:
tvayA chAyaM naravyAghra gurushushrUShayA nRRipaH |
ArAdhitaH sabhRRityena gAndhArI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.17:
anujAnIhi pitaraM samayo.asya tapovidhau |
na manyurvidyate chAsya susUkShmo.api yudhiShThira
shlokas.18:
etAvaduktvA vachanamanuj~nApya cha pArthivam |
tathAstviti cha tenoktaH kaunteyena yayau vanam
shlokas.19:
gate bhagavati vyAse rAjA pANDusutastataH |
provAcha pitaraM vRRiddhaM mandaM mandamivAnataH
shlokas.20:
yadAha bhagavAnvyAso yachchApi bhavato matam |
yadAha cha maheShvAsaH kRRipo vidura eva cha
shlokas.21:
yuyutsuH sa~njayashchaiva tatkartAsmyahama~njasA |
sarve hyete.anumAnyA me kulasyAsya hitaiShiNaH
shlokas.22:
idaM tu yAche nRRipate tvAmahaM shirasA nataH |
kriyatAM tAvadAhArastato gachChAshramaM prati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato rAj~nAbhyanuj~nAto dhRRitarAShTraH pratApavAn |
yayau svabhavanaM rAjA gAndhAryAnugatastadA
shlokas.2:
mandaprANagatirdhImAnkRRichChrAdiva samuddharan |
padAtiH sa mahIpAlo jIrNo gajapatiryathA
shlokas.3:
tamanvagachChadviduro vidvAnsUtashcha sa~njayaH |
sa chApi parameShvAsaH kRRipaH shAradvatastathA
shlokas.4:
sa pravishya gRRihaM rAjA kRRitapUrvAhNikakriyaH |
tarpayitvA dvijashreShThAnAhAramakarottadA
shlokas.5:
gAndhArI chaiva dharmaj~nA kuntyA saha manasvinI |
vadhUbhirupachAreNa pUjitAbhu~Nkta bhArata
shlokas.6:
kRRitAhAraM kRRitAhArAH sarve te vidurAdayaH |
pANDavAshcha kurushreShThamupAtiShThanta taM nRRipam
shlokas.7:
tato.abravInmahArAja kuntIputramupahvare |
niShaNNaM pANinA pRRiShThe sa.nspRRishannambikAsutaH
shlokas.8:
apramAdastvayA kAryaH sarvathA kurunandana |
aShTA~Nge rAjashArdUla rAjye dharmapuraskRRite
shlokas.9:
tattu shakyaM yathA tAta rakShituM pANDunandana |
rAjyaM dharmaM cha kaunteya vidvAnasi nibodha tat
shlokas.10:
vidyAvRRiddhAnsadaiva tvamupAsIthA yudhiShThira |
shRRiNuyAste cha yadbrUyuH kuryAshchaivAvichArayan
shlokas.11:
prAtarutthAya tAnrAjanpUjayitvA yathAvidhi |
kRRityakAle samutpanne pRRichChethAH kAryamAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
te tu saMmAnitA rAja.nstvayA rAjyahitArthinA |
pravakShyanti hitaM tAta sarvaM kauravanandana
shlokas.13:
indriyANi cha sarvANi vAjivatparipAlaya |
hitAya vai bhaviShyanti rakShitaM draviNaM yathA
shlokas.14:
amAtyAnupadhAtItAnpitRRipaitAmahA~nshuchIn |
dAntAnkarmasu sarveShu mukhyAnmukhyeShu yojayeH
shlokas.15:
chArayethAshcha satataM chArairaviditaiH parAn |
parIkShitairbahuvidhaM svarAShTreShu pareShu cha
shlokas.16:
puraM cha te suguptaM syAddRRiDhaprAkAratoraNam |
aTTATTAlakasambAdhaM ShaTpathaM sarvatodisham
shlokas.17:
tasya dvArANi kAryANi paryAptAni bRRihanti cha |
sarvataH suvibhaktAni yantrairArakShitAni cha
shlokas.18:
puruShairalamarthaj~nairviditaiH kulashIlataH |
AtmA cha rakShyaH satataM bhojanAdiShu bhArata
shlokas.19:
vihArAhArakAleShu mAlyashayyAsaneShu cha |
striyashcha te suguptAH syurvRRiddhairAptairadhiShThitAH
shIlavadbhiH kulInaishcha vidvadbhishcha yudhiShThira
shlokas.20:
mantriNashchaiva kurvIthA dvijAnvidyAvishAradAn |
vinItA.nshcha kulInA.nshcha dharmArthakushalAnRRijUn
shlokas.21:
taiH sArdhaM mantrayethAstvaM nAtyarthaM bahubhiH saha |
samastairapi cha vyastairvyapadeshena kenachit
shlokas.22:
susa.nvRRitaM mantragRRihaM sthalaM chAruhya mantrayeH |
araNye niHshalAke vA na cha rAtrau katha~nchana
shlokas.23:
vAnarAH pakShiNashchaiva ye manuShyAnukAriNaH |
sarve mantragRRihe varjyA ye chApi jaDapa~NgukAH
shlokas.24:
mantrabhede hi ye doShA bhavanti pRRithivIkShitAm |
na te shakyAH samAdhAtuM katha~nchiditi me matiH
shlokas.25:
doShA.nshcha mantrabhedeShu brUyAstvaM mantrimaNDale |
abhede cha guNAnrAjanpunaH punarari.ndama
shlokas.26:
paurajAnapadAnAM cha shauchAshauchaM yudhiShThira |
yathA syAdviditaM rAja.nstathA kAryamari.ndama

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
vyavahArAshcha te tAta nityamAptairadhiShThitAH |
yojyAstuShTairhitai rAjannityaM chArairanuShThitAH
shlokas.2:
parimANaM viditvA cha daNDaM daNDyeShu bhArata |
praNayeyuryathAnyAyaM puruShAste yudhiShThira
shlokas.3:
AdAnaruchayashchaiva paradArAbhimarshakAH |
ugradaNDapradhAnAshcha mithyA vyAhAriNastathA
shlokas.4:
AkroShTArashcha lubdhAshcha hantAraH sAhasapriyAH |
sabhAvihArabhettAro varNAnAM cha pradUShakAH
hiraNyadaNDyA vadhyAshcha kartavyA deshakAlataH
shlokas.5:
prAtareva hi pashyethA ye kuryurvyayakarma te |
ala~NkAramatho bhojyamata UrdhvaM samAchareH
shlokas.6:
pashyethAshcha tato yodhAnsadA tvaM pariharShayan |
dUtAnAM cha charANAM cha pradoShaste sadA bhavet
shlokas.7:
sadA chApararAtraM te bhavetkAryArthanirNaye |
madhyarAtre vihAraste madhyAhne cha sadA bhavet
shlokas.8:
sarve tvAtyayikAH kAlAH kAryANAM bharatarShabha |
tathaivAla~NkRRitaH kAle tiShThethA bhUridakShiNaH
chakravatkarmaNAM tAta paryAyo hyeSha nityashaH
shlokas.9:
koshasya sa~nchaye yatnaM kurvIthA nyAyataH sadA |
dvividhasya mahArAja viparItaM vivarjayeH
shlokas.10:
chArairviditvA shatrU.nshcha ye te rAjyAntarAyiNaH |
tAnAptaiH puruShairdUrAdghAtayethAH parasparam
shlokas.11:
karmadRRiShTyAtha bhRRityA.nstvaM varayethAH kurUdvaha |
kArayethAshcha karmANi yuktAyuktairadhiShThitaiH
shlokas.12:
senApraNetA cha bhavettava tAta dRRiDhavrataH |
shUraH kleshasahashchaiva priyashcha tava mAnavaH
shlokas.13:
sarve jAnapadAshchaiva tava karmANi pANDava |
paurogavAshcha sabhyAshcha kuryurye vyavahAriNaH
shlokas.14:
svarandhraM pararandhraM cha sveShu chaiva pareShu cha |
upalakShayitavyaM te nityameva yudhiShThira
shlokas.15:
deshAntarasthAshcha narA vikrAntAH sarvakarmasu |
mAtrAbhiranurUpAbhiranugrAhyA hitAstvayA
shlokas.16:
guNArthinAM guNaH kAryo viduShAM te janAdhipa |
avichAlyAshcha te te syuryathA merurmahAgiriH

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
maNDalAni cha budhyethAH pareShAmAtmanastathA |
udAsInaguNAnAM cha madhyamAnAM tathaiva cha
shlokas.2:
chaturNAM shatrujAtAnAM sarveShAmAtatAyinAm |
mitraM chAmitramitraM cha boddhavyaM te.arikarshana
shlokas.3:
tathAmAtyA janapadA durgANi viShamANi cha |
balAni cha kurushreShTha bhavantyeShAM yathechChakam
shlokas.4:
te cha dvAdasha kaunteya rAj~nAM vai vividhAtmakAH |
mantripradhAnAshcha guNAH ShaShTirdvAdasha cha prabho
shlokas.5:
etanmaNDalamityAhurAchAryA nItikovidAH |
atra ShADguNyamAyattaM yudhiShThira nibodha tat
shlokas.6:
vRRiddhikShayau cha vij~neyau sthAnaM cha kurunandana |
dvisaptatyA mahAbAho tataH ShADguNyachAriNaH
shlokas.7:
yadA svapakSho balavAnparapakShastathAbalaH |
vigRRihya shatrUnkaunteya yAyAtkShitipatistadA
yadA svapakSho.abalavA.nstadA sandhiM samAshrayet
shlokas.8:
dravyANAM sa~nchayashchaiva kartavyaH syAnmahA.nstathA |
yadA samartho yAnAya nachireNaiva bhArata
shlokas.9:
tadA sarvaM vidheyaM syAtsthAnaM cha na vibhAjayet |
bhUmiralpaphalA deyA viparItasya bhArata
shlokas.10:
hiraNyaM kupyabhUyiShThaM mitraM kShINamakoshavat |
viparItAnna gRRihNIyAtsvayaM sandhivishAradaH
shlokas.11:
sandhyarthaM rAjaputraM cha lipsethA bharatarShabha |
viparItastu te.adeyaH putra kasyA~nchidApadi
tasya pramokShe yatnaM cha kuryAH sopAyamantravit
shlokas.12:
prakRRitInAM cha kaunteya rAjA dInAM vibhAvayet |
krameNa yugapaddva.ndvaM vyasanAnAM balAbalam
shlokas.13:
pIDanaM stambhanaM chaiva koshabha~Ngastathaiva cha |
kAryaM yatnena shatrUNAM svarAShTraM rakShatA svayam
shlokas.14:
na cha hi.nsyo.abhyupagataH sAmanto vRRiddhimichChatA |
kaunteya taM na hi.nseta yo mahIM vijigIShate
shlokas.15:
gaNAnAM bhedane yogaM gachChethAH saha mantribhiH |
sAdhusa~NgrahaNAchchaiva pApanigrahaNAttathA
shlokas.16:
durbalAshchApi satataM nAvaShTabhyA balIyasA |
tiShThethA rAjashArdUla vaitasIM vRRittimAsthitaH
shlokas.17:
yadyevamabhiyAyAchcha durbalaM balavAnnRRipaH |
sAmAdibhirupAyaistaM krameNa vinivartayet
shlokas.18:
ashaknuva.nstu yuddhAya niShpatetsaha mantribhiH |
koshena paurairdaNDena ye chAnye priyakAriNaH
shlokas.19:
asambhave tu sarvasya yathAmukhyena niShpatet |
krameNAnena mokShaH syAchCharIramapi kevalam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
sandhivigrahamapyatra pashyethA rAjasattama |
dviyoniM trividhopAyaM bahukalpaM yudhiShThira
shlokas.2:
rAjendra paryupAsIthAshChittvA dvaividhyamAtmanaH |
tuShTapuShTabalaH shatrurAtmavAniti cha smaret
shlokas.3:
paryupAsanakAle tu viparItaM vidhIyate |
AmardakAle rAjendra vyapasarpastato varaH
shlokas.4:
vyasanaM bhedanaM chaiva shatrUNAM kArayettataH |
karshanaM bhIShaNaM chaiva yuddhe chApi bahukShayam
shlokas.5:
prayAsyamAno nRRipatistrividhaM parichintayet |
Atmanashchaiva shatroshcha shaktiM shAstravishAradaH
shlokas.6:
utsAhaprabhushaktibhyAM mantrashaktyA cha bhArata |
upapanno naro yAyAdviparItamato.anyathA
shlokas.7:
AdadIta balaM rAjA maulaM mitrabalaM tathA |
aTavIbalaM bhRRitaM chaiva tathA shreNIbalaM cha yat
shlokas.8:
tatra mitrabalaM rAjanmaulena na vishiShyate |
shreNIbalaM bhRRitaM chaiva tulya eveti me matiH
shlokas.9:
tathA chArabalaM chaiva parasparasamaM nRRipa |
vij~neyaM balakAleShu rAj~nA kAla upasthite
shlokas.10:
ApadashchApi boddhavyA bahurUpA narAdhipa |
bhavanti rAj~nAM kauravya yAstAH pRRithagataH shRRiNu
shlokas.11:
vikalpA bahavo rAjannApadAM pANDunandana |
sAmAdibhirupanyasya shamayettAnnRRipaH sadA
shlokas.12:
yAtrAM yAyAdbalairyukto rAjA ShaDbhiH parantapa |
sa.nyukto deshakAlAbhyAM balairAtmaguNaistathA
shlokas.13:
tuShTapuShTabalo yAyAdrAjA vRRiddhyudaye rataH |
AhUtashchApyatho yAyAdanRRitAvapi pArthivaH
shlokas.14:
sthUNAshmAnaM vAjirathapradhAnAM; dhvajadrumaiH sa.nvRRitakUlarodhasam |
padAtinAgairbahukardamAM nadIM; sapatnanAshe nRRipatiH prayAyAt
shlokas.15:
athopapattyA shakaTaM padmaM vajraM cha bhArata |
ushanA veda yachChAstraM tatraitadvihitaM vibho
shlokas.16:
sAdayitvA parabalaM kRRitvA cha balaharShaNam |
svabhUmau yojayedyuddhaM parabhUmau tathaiva cha
shlokas.17:
labdhaM prashamayedrAjA nikShipeddhanino narAn |
j~nAtvA svaviShayaM taM cha sAmAdibhirupakramet
shlokas.18:
sarvathaiva mahArAja sharIraM dhArayediha |
pretyeha chaiva kartavyamAtmaniHshreyasaM param
shlokas.19:
evaM kurva~nshubhA vAcho loke.asmi~nshRRiNute nRRipaH |
pretya svargaM tathApnoti prajA dharmeNa pAlayan
shlokas.20:
evaM tvayA kurushreShTha vartitavyaM prajAhitam |
ubhayorlokayostAta prAptaye nityameva cha
shlokas.21:
bhIShmeNa pUrvamukto.asi kRRiShNena vidureNa cha |
mayApyavashyaM vaktavyaM prItyA te nRRipasattama
shlokas.22:
etatsarvaM yathAnyAyaM kurvIthA bhUridakShiNa |
priyastathA prajAnAM tvaM svarge sukhamavApsyasi
shlokas.23:
ashvamedhasahasreNa yo yajetpRRithivIpatiH |
pAlayedvApi dharmeNa prajAstulyaM phalaM labhet

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
evametatkariShyAmi yathAttha pRRithivIpate |
bhUyashchaivAnushAsyo.ahaM bhavatA pArthivarShabha
shlokas.2:
bhIShme svargamanuprApte gate cha madhusUdane |
vidure sa~njaye chaiva ko.anyo mAM vaktumarhati
shlokas.3:
yattu mAmanushAstIha bhavAnadya hite sthitaH |
kartAsmyetanmahIpAla nirvRRito bhava bhArata
shlokas.4:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktaH sa rAjarShirdharmarAjena dhImatA |
kaunteyaM samanuj~nAtumiyeSha bharatarShabha
shlokas.5:
putra vishramyatAM tAvanmamApi balavA~nshramaH |
ityuktvA prAvishadrAjA gAndhAryA bhavanaM tadA
shlokas.6:
tamAsanagataM devI gAndhArI dharmachAriNI |
uvAcha kAle kAlaj~nA prajApatisamaM patim
shlokas.7:
anuj~nAtaH svayaM tena vyAsenApi maharShiNA |
yudhiShThirasyAnumate kadAraNyaM gamiShyasi
shlokas.8:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
gAndhAryahamanuj~nAtaH svayaM pitrA mahAtmanA |
yudhiShThirasyAnumate gantAsmi nachirAdvanam
shlokas.9:
ahaM hi nAma sarveShAM teShAM durdyUtadevinAm |
putrANAM dAtumichChAmi pretyabhAvAnugaM vasu
sarvaprakRRitisAMnidhyaM kArayitvA svaveshmani
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityuktvA dharmarAjAya preShayAmAsa pArthivaH |
sa cha tadvachanAtsarvaM samAninye mahIpatiH
shlokas.11:
tato niShkramya nRRipatistasmAdantaHpurAttadA |
sarvaM suhRRijjanaM chaiva sarvAshcha prakRRitIstathA
samavetA.nshcha tAnsarvAnpaurajAnapadAnatha
shlokas.12:
brAhmaNA.nshcha mahIpAlAnnAnAdeshasamAgatAn |
tataH prAha mahAtejA dhRRitarAShTro mahIpatiH
shlokas.13:
shRRiNvantyekAgramanaso brAhmaNAH kurujA~NgalAH |
kShatriyAshchaiva vaishyAshcha shUdrAshchaiva samAgatAH
shlokas.14:
bhavantaH kuravashchaiva bahukAlaM sahoShitAH |
parasparasya suhRRidaH parasparahite ratAH
shlokas.15:
yadidAnImahaM brUyAmasminkAla upasthite |
tathA bhavadbhiH kartavyamavichArya vacho mama
shlokas.16:
araNyagamane buddhirgAndhArIsahitasya me |
vyAsasyAnumate rAj~nastathA kuntIsutasya cha
bhavanto.apyanujAnantu mA vo.anyA bhUdvichAraNA
shlokas.17:
asmAkaM bhavatAM chaiva yeyaM prItirhi shAshvatI |
na chAnyeShvasti desheShu rAj~nAmiti matirmama
shlokas.18:
shrAnto.asmi vayasAnena tathA putravinAkRRitaH |
upavAsakRRishashchAsmi gAndhArIsahito.anaghAH
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThiragate rAjye prAptashchAsmi sukhaM mahat |
manye duryodhanaishvaryAdvishiShTamiti sattamAH
shlokas.20:
mama tvandhasya vRRiddhasya hataputrasya kA gatiH |
RRite vanaM mahAbhAgAstanmAnuj~nAtumarhatha
shlokas.21:
tasya tadvachanaM shrutvA sarve te kurujA~NgalAH |
bAShpasa.ndigdhayA vAchA rurudurbharatarShabha
shlokas.22:
tAnavibruvataH ki~nchidduHkhashokaparAyaNAn |
punareva mahAtejA dhRRitarAShTro.abravIdidam

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
shantanuH pAlayAmAsa yathAvatpRRithivImimAm |
tathA vichitravIryashcha bhIShmeNa paripAlitaH
pAlayAmAsa vastAto viditaM vo nasa.nshayaH
shlokas.2:
yathA cha pANDurbhrAtA me dayito bhavatAmabhUt |
sa chApi pAlayAmAsa yathAvattachcha vettha ha
shlokas.3:
mayA cha bhavatAM samyakChushrUShA yA kRRitAnaghAH |
asamyagvA mahAbhAgAstatkShantavyamatandritaiH
shlokas.4:
yachcha duryodhanenedaM rAjyaM bhuktamakaNTakam |
api tatra na vo mando durbuddhiraparAddhavAn
shlokas.5:
tasyAparAdhAddurbuddherabhimAnAnmahIkShitAm |
vimardaH sumahAnAsIdanayAnmatkRRitAdatha
shlokas.6:
tanmayA sAdhu vApIdaM yadi vAsAdhu vai kRRitam |
tadvo hRRidi na kartavyaM mAmanuj~nAtumarhatha
shlokas.7:
vRRiddho.ayaM hataputro.ayaM duHkhito.ayaM janAdhipaH |
pUrvarAj~nAM cha putro.ayamiti kRRitvAnujAnata
shlokas.8:
iyaM cha kRRipaNA vRRiddhA hataputrA tapasvinI |
gAndhArI putrashokArtA tulyaM yAchati vo mayA
shlokas.9:
hataputrAvimau vRRiddhau viditvA duHkhitau tathA |
anujAnIta bhadraM vo vrajAvaH sharaNaM cha vaH
shlokas.10:
ayaM cha kauravo rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
sarvairbhavadbhirdraShTavyaH sameShu viShameShu cha
na jAtu viShamaM chaiva gamiShyati kadAchana
shlokas.11:
chatvAraH sachivA yasya bhrAtaro vipulaujasaH |
lokapAlopamA hyete sarve dharmArthadarshinaH
shlokas.12:
brahmeva bhagavAneSha sarvabhUtajagatpatiH |
yudhiShThiro mahAtejA bhavataH pAlayiShyati
shlokas.13:
avashyameva vaktavyamiti kRRitvA bravImi vaH |
eSha nyAso mayA dattaH sarveShAM vo yudhiShThiraH
bhavanto.asya cha vIrasya nyAsabhUtA mayA kRRitAH
shlokas.14:
yadyeva taiH kRRitaM ki~nchidvyalIkaM vA sutairmama |
yadyanyena madIyena tadanuj~nAtumarhatha
shlokas.15:
bhavadbhirhi na me manyuH kRRitapUrvaH katha~nchana |
atyantagurubhaktAnAmeSho.a~njaliridaM namaH
shlokas.16:
teShAmasthirabuddhInAM lubdhAnAM kAmachAriNAm |
kRRite yAchAmi vaH sarvAngAndhArIsahito.anaghAH
shlokas.17:
ityuktAstena te rAj~nA paurajAnapadA janAH |
nochurbAShpakalAH ki~nchidvIkShAM chakruH parasparam

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktAstu te tena paurajAnapadA janAH |
vRRiddhena rAj~nA kauravya naShTasa~nj~nA ivAbhavan
shlokas.2:
tUShNImbhUtA.nstatastA.nstu bAShpakaNThAnmahIpatiH |
dhRRitarAShTro mahIpAlaH punarevAbhyabhAShata
shlokas.3:
vRRiddhaM mAM hataputraM cha dharmapatnyA sahAnayA |
vilapantaM bahuvidhaM kRRipaNaM chaiva sattamAH
shlokas.4:
pitrA svayamanuj~nAtaM kRRiShNadvaipAyanena vai |
vanavAsAya dharmaj~nA dharmaj~nena nRRipeNa cha
shlokas.5:
so.ahaM punaH punaryAche shirasAvanato.anaghAH |
gAndhAryA sahitaM tanmAM samanuj~nAtumarhatha
shlokas.6:
shrutvA tu kururAjasya vAkyAni karuNAni te |
ruruduH sarvato rAjansametAH kurujA~NgalAH
shlokas.7:
uttarIyaiH karaishchApi sa~nChAdya vadanAni te |
ruruduH shokasantaptA muhUrtaM pitRRimAtRRivat
shlokas.8:
hRRidayaiH shUnyabhUtaiste dhRRitarAShTrapravAsajam |
duHkhaM sandhArayantaH sma naShTasa~nj~nA ivAbhavan
shlokas.9:
te vinIya tamAyAsaM kururAjaviyogajam |
shanaiH shanaistadAnyonyamabruvansvamatAnyuta
shlokas.10:
tataH sandhAya te sarve vAkyAnyatha samAsataH |
ekasminbrAhmaNe rAjannAveshyochurnarAdhipam
shlokas.11:
tataH svacharaNe vRRiddhaH saMmato.arthavishAradaH |
sAmbAkhyo bahvRRicho rAjanvaktuM samupachakrame
shlokas.12:
anumAnya mahArAjaM tatsadaH samprabhAShya cha |
vipraH pragalbho medhAvI sa rAjAnamuvAcha ha
shlokas.13:
rAjanvAkyaM janasyAsya mayi sarvaM samarpitam |
vakShyAmi tadahaM vIra tajjuShasva narAdhipa
shlokas.14:
yathA vadasi rAjendra sarvametattathA vibho |
nAtra mithyA vachaH ki~nchitsuhRRittvaM naH parasparam
shlokas.15:
na jAtvasya tu va.nshasya rAj~nAM kashchitkadAchana |
rAjAsIdyaH prajApAlaH prajAnAmapriyo bhavet
shlokas.16:
pitRRivadbhrAtRRivachchaiva bhavantaH pAlayanti naH |
na cha duryodhanaH ki~nchidayuktaM kRRitavAnnRRipa
shlokas.17:
yathA bravIti dharmaj~no muniH satyavatIsutaH |
tathA kuru mahArAja sa hi naH paramo guruH
shlokas.18:
tyaktA vayaM tu bhavatA duHkhashokaparAyaNAH |
bhaviShyAmashchiraM rAjanbhavadguNashatairhRRitAH
shlokas.19:
yathA shantanunA guptA rAj~nA chitrA~Ngadena cha |
bhIShmavIryopagUDhena pitrA cha tava pArthiva
shlokas.20:
bhavadbuddhiyujA chaiva pANDunA pRRithivIkShitA |
tathA duryodhanenApi rAj~nA suparipAlitAH
shlokas.21:
na svalpamapi putraste vyalIkaM kRRitavAnnRRipa |
pitarIva suvishvastAstasminnapi narAdhipe
vayamAsma yathA samyagbhavato viditaM tathA
shlokas.22:
tathA varShasahasrAya kuntIputreNa dhImatA |
pAlyamAnA dhRRitimatA sukhaM vindAmahe nRRipa
shlokas.23:
rAjarShINAM purANAnAM bhavatAM va.nshadhAriNAm |
kurusa.nvaraNAdInAM bharatasya cha dhImataH
shlokas.24:
vRRittaM samanuyAtyeSha dharmAtmA bhUridakShiNaH |
nAtra vAchyaM mahArAja susUkShmamapi vidyate
shlokas.25:
uShitAH sma sukhaM nityaM bhavatA paripAlitAH |
susUkShmaM cha vyalIkaM te saputrasya na vidyate
shlokas.26:
yattu j~nAtivimarde.asminnAttha duryodhanaM prati |
bhavantamanuneShyAmi tatrApi kurunandana

shlokas.1:
brAhmaNa uvAcha||
na tadduryodhanakRRitaM na cha tadbhavatA kRRitam |
na karNasaubalAbhyAM cha kuravo yatkShayaM gatAH
shlokas.2:
daivaM tattu vijAnImo yanna shakyaM prabAdhitum |
daivaM puruShakAreNa na shakyamativartitum
shlokas.3:
akShauhiNyo mahArAja dashAShTau cha samAgatAH |
aShTAdashAhena hatA dashabhiryodhapu~NgavaiH
shlokas.4:
bhIShmadroNakRRipAdyaishcha karNena cha mahAtmanA |
yuyudhAnena vIreNa dhRRiShTadyumnena chaiva ha
shlokas.5:
chaturbhiH pANDuputraishcha bhImArjunayamairnRRipa |
janakShayo.ayaM nRRipate kRRito daivabalAtkRRitaiH
shlokas.6:
avashyameva sa~NgrAme kShatriyeNa visheShataH |
kartavyaM nidhanaM loke shastreNa kShatrabandhunA
shlokas.7:
tairiyaM puruShavyAghrairvidyAbAhubalAnvitaiH |
pRRithivI nihatA sarvA sahayA sarathadvipA
shlokas.8:
na sa rAjAparAdhnoti putrastava mahAmanAH |
na bhavAnna cha te bhRRityA na karNo na cha saubalaH
shlokas.9:
yadvinaShTAH kurushreShThA rAjAnashcha sahasrashaH |
sarvaM daivakRRitaM tadvai ko.atra kiM vaktumarhati
shlokas.10:
gururmato bhavAnasya kRRitsnasya jagataH prabhuH |
dharmAtmAnamatastubhyamanujAnImahe sutam
shlokas.11:
labhatAM vIralokAnsa sasahAyo narAdhipaH |
dvijAgryaiH samanuj~nAtastridive modatAM sukhI
shlokas.12:
prApsyate cha bhavAnpuNyaM dharme cha paramAM sthitim |
veda puNyaM cha kArtsnyena samyagbharatasattama
shlokas.13:
dRRiShTApadAnAshchAsmAbhiH pANDavAH puruSharShabhAH |
samarthAstridivasyApi pAlane kiM punaH kShiteH
shlokas.14:
anuvatsyanti chApImAH sameShu viShameShu cha |
prajAH kurukulashreShTha pANDavA~nshIlabhUShaNAn
shlokas.15:
brahmadeyAgrahArA.nshcha parihArA.nshcha pArthiva |
pUrvarAjAtisargA.nshcha pAlayatyeva pANDavaH
shlokas.16:
dIrghadarshI kRRitapraj~naH sadA vaishravaNo yathA |
akShudrasachivashchAyaM kuntIputro mahAmanAH
shlokas.17:
apyamitre dayAvA.nshcha shuchishcha bharatarShabha |
RRiju pashyati medhAvI putravatpAti naH sadA
shlokas.18:
vipriyaM cha janasyAsya sa.nsargAddharmajasya vai |
na kariShyanti rAjarShe tathA bhImArjunAdayaH
shlokas.19:
mandA mRRiduShu kauravyAstIkShNeShvAshIviShopamAH |
vIryavanto mahAtmAnaH paurANAM cha hite ratAH
shlokas.20:
na kuntI na cha pA~nchAlI na cholUpI na sAtvatI |
asmi~njane kariShyanti pratikUlAni karhichit
shlokas.21:
bhavatkRRitamimaM snehaM yudhiShThiravivardhitam |
na pRRiShThataH kariShyanti paurajAnapadA janAH
shlokas.22:
adharmiShThAnapi sataH kuntIputrA mahArathAH |
mAnavAnpAlayiShyanti bhUtvA dharmaparAyaNAH
shlokas.23:
sa rAjanmAnasaM duHkhamapanIya yudhiShThirAt |
kuru kAryANi dharmyANi namaste bharatarShabha
shlokas.24:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tasya tadvachanaM dharmyamanubandhaguNottaram |
sAdhu sAdhviti sarvaH sa janaH pratigRRihItavAn
shlokas.25:
dhRRitarAShTrashcha tadvAkyamabhipUjya punaH punaH |
visarjayAmAsa tadA sarvAstu prakRRitIH shanaiH
shlokas.26:
sa taiH sampUjito rAjA shivenAvekShitastadA |
prA~njaliH pUjayAmAsa taM janaM bharatarShabha
shlokas.27:
tato vivesha bhuvanaM gAndhAryA sahito nRRipaH |
vyuShTAyAM chaiva sharvaryAM yachchakAra nibodha tat

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vyuShitAyAM rajanyAM tu dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
viduraM preShayAmAsa yudhiShThiraniveshanam
shlokas.2:
sa gatvA rAjavachanAduvAchAchyutamIshvaram |
yudhiShThiraM mahAtejAH sarvabuddhimatAM varaH
shlokas.3:
dhRRitarAShTro mahArAja vanavAsAya dIkShitaH |
gamiShyati vanaM rAjankArttikImAgatAmimAm
shlokas.4:
sa tvA kurukulashreShTha ki~nchidarthamabhIpsati |
shrAddhamichChati dAtuM sa gA~Ngeyasya mahAtmanaH
shlokas.5:
droNasya somadattasya bAhlIkasya cha dhImataH |
putrANAM chaiva sarveShAM ye chAsya suhRRido hatAH
yadi chAbhyanujAnIShe saindhavApasadasya cha
shlokas.6:
etachChrutvA tu vachanaM vidurasya yudhiShThiraH |
hRRiShTaH sampUjayAmAsa guDAkeshashcha pANDavaH
shlokas.7:
na tu bhImo dRRiDhakrodhastadvacho jagRRihe tadA |
vidurasya mahAtejA duryodhanakRRitaM smaran
shlokas.8:
abhiprAyaM viditvA tu bhImasenasya phalgunaH |
kirITI ki~nchidAnamya bhImaM vachanamabravIt
shlokas.9:
bhIma rAjA pitA vRRiddho vanavAsAya dIkShitaH |
dAtumichChati sarveShAM suhRRidAmaurdhvadehikam
shlokas.10:
bhavatA nirjitaM vittaM dAtumichChati kauravaH |
bhIShmAdInAM mahAbAho tadanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.11:
diShTyA tvadya mahAbAho dhRRitarAShTraH prayAchati |
yAchito yaH purAsmAbhiH pashya kAlasya paryayam
shlokas.12:
yo.asau pRRithivyAH kRRitsnAyA bhartA bhUtvA narAdhipaH |
parairvinihatApatyo vanaM gantumabhIpsati
shlokas.13:
mA te.anyatpuruShavyAghra dAnAdbhavatu darshanam |
ayashasyamato.anyatsyAdadharmyaM cha mahAbhuja
shlokas.14:
rAjAnamupatiShThasva jyeShThaM bhrAtaramIshvaram |
arhastvamasi dAtuM vai nAdAtuM bharatarShabha
evaM bruvANaM kaunteyaM dharmarAjo.abhyapUjayat
shlokas.15:
bhImasenastu sakrodhaH provAchedaM vachastadA |
vayaM bhIShmasya kurmeha pretakAryANi phalguna
shlokas.16:
somadattasya nRRipaterbhUrishravasa eva cha |
bAhlIkasya cha rAjarSherdroNasya cha mahAtmanaH
shlokas.17:
anyeShAM chaiva suhRRidAM kuntI karNAya dAsyati |
shrAddhAni puruShavyAghra mAdAtkauravako nRRipaH
shlokas.18:
iti me vartate buddhirmA vo nandantu shatravaH |
kaShTAtkaShTataraM yAntu sarve duryodhanAdayaH
yairiyaM pRRithivI sarvA ghAtitA kulapA.nsanaiH
shlokas.19:
kutastvamadya vismRRitya vairaM dvAdashavArShikam |
aj~nAtavAsagamanaM draupadIshokavardhanam
kva tadA dhRRitarAShTrasya sneho.asmAsvabhavattadA
shlokas.20:
kRRiShNAjinopasa.nvIto hRRitAbharaNabhUShaNaH |
sArdhaM pA~nchAlaputryA tvaM rAjAnamupajagmivAn
kva tadA droNabhIShmau tau somadatto.api vAbhavat
shlokas.21:
yatra trayodasha samA vane vanyena jIvasi |
na tadA tvA pitA jyeShThaH pitRRitvenAbhivIkShate
shlokas.22:
kiM te tadvismRRitaM pArtha yadeSha kulapA.nsanaH |
durvRRitto viduraM prAha dyUte kiM jitamityuta
shlokas.23:
tameva.nvAdinaM rAjA kuntIputro yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha bhrAtaraM dhImA~njoShamAsveti bhartsayan

shlokas.1:
arjuna uvAcha||
bhIma jyeShTho gururme tvaM nAto.anyadvaktumutsahe |
dhRRitarAShTro hi rAjarShiH sarvathA mAnamarhati
shlokas.2:
na smarantyaparAddhAni smaranti sukRRitAni cha |
asambhinnArthamaryAdAH sAdhavaH puruShottamAH
shlokas.3:
idaM madvachanAtkShattaH kauravaM brUhi pArthivam |
yAvadichChati putrANAM dAtuM tAvaddadAmyaham
shlokas.4:
bhIShmAdInAM cha sarveShAM suhRRidAmupakAriNAm |
mama koshAditi vibho mA bhUdbhImaH sudurmanAH
shlokas.5:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityukte dharmarAjastamarjunaM pratyapUjayat |
bhImasenaH kaTAkSheNa vIkShAM chakre dhana~njayam
shlokas.6:
tataH sa viduraM dhImAnvAkyamAha yudhiShThiraH |
na bhImasene kopaM sa nRRipatiH kartumarhati
shlokas.7:
parikliShTo hi bhImo.ayaM himavRRiShTyAtapAdibhiH |
duHkhairbahuvidhairdhImAnaraNye viditaM tava
shlokas.8:
kiM tu madvachanAdbrUhi rAjAnaM bharatarShabham |
yadyadichChasi yAvachcha gRRihyatAM madgRRihAditi
shlokas.9:
yanmAtsaryamayaM bhImaH karoti bhRRishaduHkhitaH |
na tanmanasi kartavyamiti vAchyaH sa pArthivaH
shlokas.10:
yanmamAsti dhanaM ki~nchidarjunasya cha veshmani |
tasya svAmI mahArAja iti vAchyaH sa pArthivaH
shlokas.11:
dadAtu rAjA viprebhyo yatheShTaM kriyatAM vyayaH |
putrANAM suhRRidAM chaiva gachChatvAnRRiNyamadya saH
shlokas.12:
idaM chApi sharIraM me tavAyattaM janAdhipa |
dhanAni cheti viddhi tvaM kShattarnAstyatra sa.nshayaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evamuktastu rAj~nA sa viduro buddhisattamaH |
dhRRitarAShTramupetyedaM vAkyamAha mahArthavat
shlokas.2:
ukto yudhiShThiro rAjA bhavadvachanamAditaH |
sa cha sa.nshrutya vAkyaM te prashasha.nsa mahAdyutiH
shlokas.3:
bIbhatsushcha mahAtejA nivedayati te gRRihAn |
vasu tasya gRRihe yachcha prANAnapi cha kevalAn
shlokas.4:
dharmarAjashcha putraste rAjyaM prANAndhanAni cha |
anujAnAti rAjarShe yachchAnyadapi ki~nchana
shlokas.5:
bhImastu sarvaduHkhAni sa.nsmRRitya bahulAnyuta |
kRRichChrAdiva mahAbAhuranumanye viniHshvasan
shlokas.6:
sa rAj~nA dharmashIlena bhrAtrA bIbhatsunA tathA |
anunIto mahAbAhuH sauhRRide sthApito.api cha
shlokas.7:
na cha manyustvayA kArya iti tvAM prAha dharmarAT |
sa.nsmRRitya bhImastadvairaM yadanyAyavadAcharet
shlokas.8:
evamprAyo hi dharmo.ayaM kShatriyANAM narAdhipa |
yuddhe kShatriyadharme cha nirato.ayaM vRRikodaraH
shlokas.9:
vRRikodarakRRite chAhamarjunashcha punaH punaH |
prasAdayAva nRRipate bhavAnprabhurihAsti yat
shlokas.10:
pradadAtu bhavAnvittaM yAvadichChasi pArthiva |
tvamIshvaro no rAjyasya prANAnAM cheti bhArata
shlokas.11:
brahmadeyAgrahArA.nshcha putrANAM chaurdhvadehikam |
ito ratnAni gAshchaiva dAsIdAsamajAvikam
shlokas.12:
AnayitvA kurushreShTho brAhmaNebhyaH prayachChatu |
dInAndhakRRipaNebhyashcha tatra tatra nRRipAj~nayA
shlokas.13:
bahvannarasapAnADhyAH sabhA vidura kAraya |
gavAM nipAnAnyanyachcha vividhaM puNyakarma yat
shlokas.14:
iti mAmabravIdrAjA pArthashchaiva dhana~njayaH |
yadatrAnantaraM kAryaM tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.15:
ityukto vidureNAtha dhRRitarAShTro.abhinandya tat |
manashchakre mahAdAne kArttikyAM janamejaya

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vidureNaivamuktastu dhRRitarAShTro janAdhipaH |
prItimAnabhavadrAjA rAj~no jiShNoshcha karmaNA
shlokas.2:
tato.abhirUpAnbhIShmAya brAhmaNAnRRiShisattamAn |
putrArthe suhRRidAM chaiva sa samIkShya sahasrashaH
shlokas.3:
kArayitvAnnapAnAni yAnAnyAchChAdanAni cha |
suvarNamaNiratnAni dAsIdAsaparichChadAn
shlokas.4:
kambalAjinaratnAni grAmAnkShetrAnajAvikam |
ala~NkArAngajAnashvAnkanyAshchaiva varastriyaH
AdishyAdishya viprebhyo dadau sa nRRipasattamaH
shlokas.5:
droNaM sa~NkIrtya bhIShmaM cha somadattaM cha bAhlikam |
duryodhanaM cha rAjAnaM putrA.nshchaiva pRRithakpRRithak
jayadrathapurogA.nshcha suhRRidashchaiva sarvashaH
shlokas.6:
sa shrAddhayaj~no vavRRidhe bahugodhanadakShiNaH |
anekadhanaratnaugho yudhiShThiramate tadA
shlokas.7:
anishaM yatra puruShA gaNakA lekhakAstathA |
yudhiShThirasya vachanAttadApRRichChanti taM nRRipam
shlokas.8:
Aj~nApaya kimetebhyaH pradeyaM dIyatAmiti |
tadupasthitamevAtra vachanAnte pradRRishyate
shlokas.9:
shate deye dashashataM sahasre chAyutaM tathA |
dIyate vachanAdrAj~naH kuntIputrasya dhImataH
shlokas.10:
evaM sa vasudhArAbhirvarShamANo nRRipAmbudaH |
tarpayAmAsa viprA.nstAnvarShanbhUmimivAmbudaH
shlokas.11:
tato.anantaramevAtra sarvavarNAnmahIpatiH |
annapAnarasaughena plAvayAmAsa pArthivaH
shlokas.12:
savastraphenaratnaugho mRRida~NganinadasvanaH |
gavAshvamakarAvarto nArIratnamahAkaraH
shlokas.13:
grAmAgrahArakulyADhyo maNihemajalArNavaH |
jagatsamplAvayAmAsa dhRRitarAShTradayAmbudhiH
shlokas.14:
evaM sa putrapautrANAM pitR^INAmAtmanastathA |
gAndhAryAshcha mahArAja pradadAvaurdhvadehikam
shlokas.15:
parishrAnto yadAsItsa dadaddAnAnyanekashaH |
tato nirvartayAmAsa dAnayaj~naM kurUdvahaH
shlokas.16:
evaM sa rAjA kauravyashchakre dAnamahotsavam |
naTanartakalAsyADhyaM bahvannarasadakShiNam
shlokas.17:
dashAhamevaM dAnAni dattvA rAjAmbikAsutaH |
babhUva putrapautrANAmanRRiNo bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prabhAte rAjA sa dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
AhUya pANDavAnvIrAnvanavAsakRRitakShaNaH
shlokas.2:
gAndhArIsahito dhImAnabhinandya yathAvidhi |
kArttikyAM kArayitveShTiM brAhmaNairvedapAragaiH
shlokas.3:
agnihotraM puraskRRitya valkalAjinasa.nvRRitaH |
vadhUparivRRito rAjA niryayau bhavanAttataH
shlokas.4:
tataH striyaH kauravapANDavAnAM; yAshchApyanyAH kauravarAjava.nshyAH |
tAsAM nAdaH prAdurAsIttadAnIM; vaichitravIrye nRRipatau prayAte
shlokas.5:
tato lAjaiH sumanobhishcha rAjA; vichitrAbhistadgRRihaM pUjayitvA |
sa.nyojyArthairbhRRityajanaM cha sarvaM; tataH samutsRRijya yayau narendraH
shlokas.6:
tato rAjA prA~njalirvepamAno; yudhiShThiraH sasvanaM bAShpakaNThaH |
vilapyochchairhA mahArAja sAdho; kva gantAsItyapatattAta bhUmau
shlokas.7:
tathArjunastIvraduHkhAbhitapto; muhurmuhurniHshvasanbhAratAgryaH |
yudhiShThiraM maivamityevamuktvA; nigRRihyAthodIdharatsIdamAnaH
shlokas.8:
vRRikodaraH phalgunashchaiva vIrau; mAdrIputrau viduraH sa~njayashcha |
vaishyAputraH sahito gautamena; dhaumyo viprAshchAnvayurbAShpakaNThAH
shlokas.9:
kuntI gAndhArIM baddhanetrAM vrajantIM; skandhAsaktaM hastamathodvahantI |
rAjA gAndhAryAH skandhadeshe.avasajya; pANiM yayau dhRRitarAShTraH pratItaH
shlokas.10:
tathA kRRiShNA draupadI yAdavI cha; bAlApatyA chottarA kauravI cha |
chitrA~NgadA yAshcha kAshchitstriyo.anyAH; sArdhaM rAj~nA prasthitAstA vadhUbhiH
shlokas.11:
tAsAM nAdo rudatInAM tadAsI;drAjanduHkhAtkurarINAmivochchaiH |
tato niShpeturbrAhmaNakShatriyANAM; viTshUdrANAM chaiva nAryaH samantAt
shlokas.12:
tanniryANe duHkhitaH pauravargo; gajAhvaye.atIva babhUva rAjan |
yathA pUrvaM gachChatAM pANDavAnAM; dyUte rAjankauravANAM sabhAyAm
shlokas.13:
yA nApashyachchandramA naiva sUryo; rAmAH kadAchidapi tasminnarendre |
mahAvanaM gachChati kauravendre; shokenArtA rAjamArgaM prapeduH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH prAsAdaharmyeShu vasudhAyAM cha pArthiva |
strINAM cha puruShANAM cha sumahAnnisvano.abhavat
shlokas.2:
sa rAjA rAjamArgeNa nRRinArIsa~Nkulena cha |
katha~nchinniryayau dhImAnvepamAnaH kRRitA~njaliH
shlokas.3:
sa vardhamAnadvAreNa niryayau gajasAhvayAt |
visarjayAmAsa cha taM janaughaM sa muhurmuhuH
shlokas.4:
vanaM gantuM cha viduro rAj~nA saha kRRitakShaNaH |
sa~njayashcha mahAmAtraH sUto gAvalgaNistathA
shlokas.5:
kRRipaM nivartayAmAsa yuyutsuM cha mahAratham |
dhRRitarAShTro mahIpAlaH paridAya yudhiShThire
shlokas.6:
nivRRitte pauravarge tu rAjA sAntaHpurastadA |
dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nAto nivartitumiyeSha saH
shlokas.7:
so.abravInmAtaraM kuntImupetya bharatarShabha |
ahaM rAjAnamanviShye bhavatI vinivartatAm
shlokas.8:
vadhUparivRRitA rAj~ni nagaraM gantumarhasi |
rAjA yAtveSha dharmAtmA tapase dhRRitanishchayaH
shlokas.9:
ityuktA dharmarAjena bAShpavyAkulalochanA |
jagAdaivaM tadA kuntI gAndhArIM parigRRihya ha
shlokas.10:
sahadeve mahArAja mA pramAdaM kRRithAH kvachit |
eSha mAmanurakto hi rAja.nstvAM chaiva nityadA
shlokas.11:
karNaM smarethAH satataM sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinam |
avakIrNo hi sa mayA vIro duShpraj~nayA tadA
shlokas.12:
AyasaM hRRidayaM nUnaM mandAyA mama putraka |
yatsUryajamapashyantyAH shatadhA na vidIryate
shlokas.13:
eva~Ngate tu kiM shakyaM mayA kartumari.ndama |
mama doSho.ayamatyarthaM khyApito yanna sUryajaH
tannimittaM mahAbAho dAnaM dadyAstvamuttamam
shlokas.14:
sadaiva bhrAtRRibhiH sArdhamagrajasyArimardana |
draupadyAshcha priye nityaM sthAtavyamarikarshana
shlokas.15:
bhImasenArjunau chaiva nakulashcha kurUdvaha |
samAdheyAstvayA vIra tvayyadya kuladhUrgatA
shlokas.16:
shvashrUshvashurayoH pAdA~nshushrUShantI vane tvaham |
gAndhArIsahitA vatsye tApasI malapa~NkinI
shlokas.17:
evamuktaH sa dharmAtmA bhrAtRRibhiH sahito vashI |
viShAdamagamattIvraM na cha ki~nchiduvAcha ha
shlokas.18:
sa muhUrtamiva dhyAtvA dharmaputro yudhiShThiraH |
uvAcha mAtaraM dInashchintAshokaparAyaNaH
shlokas.19:
kimidaM te vyavasitaM naivaM tvaM vaktumarhasi |
na tvAmabhyanujAnAmi prasAdaM kartumarhasi
shlokas.20:
vyarochayaH purA hyasmAnutsAhya priyadarshane |
vidurAyA vachobhistvamasmAnna tyaktumarhasi
shlokas.21:
nihatya pRRithivIpAlAnrAjyaM prAptamidaM mayA |
tava praj~nAmupashrutya vAsudevAnnararShabhAt
shlokas.22:
kva sA buddhiriyaM chAdya bhavatyA yA shrutA mayA |
kShatradharme sthitiM hyuktvA tasyAshchalitumichChasi
shlokas.23:
asmAnutsRRijya rAjyaM cha snuShAM chemAM yashasvinIm |
kathaM vatsyasi shUnyeShu vaneShvamba prasIda me
shlokas.24:
iti bAShpakalAM vAchaM kuntI putrasya shRRiNvatI |
jagAmaivAshrupUrNAkShI bhImastAmidamabravIt
shlokas.25:
yadA rAjyamidaM kunti bhoktavyaM putranirjitam |
prAptavyA rAjadharmAshcha tadeyaM te kuto matiH
shlokas.26:
kiM vayaM kAritAH pUrvaM bhavatyA pRRithivIkShayam |
kasya hetoH parityajya vanaM gantumabhIpsasi
shlokas.27:
vanAchchApi kimAnItA bhavatyA bAlakA vayam |
duHkhashokasamAviShTau mAdrIputrAvimau tathA
shlokas.28:
prasIda mAtarmA gAstvaM vanamadya yashasvini |
shriyaM yaudhiShThirIM tAvadbhu~NkShva pArthabalArjitAm
shlokas.29:
iti sA nishchitaivAtha vanavAsakRRitakShaNA |
lAlapyatAM bahuvidhaM putrANAM nAkarodvachaH
shlokas.30:
draupadI chAnvayAchChvashrUM viShaNNavadanA tadA |
vanavAsAya gachChantIM rudatI bhadrayA saha
shlokas.31:
sA putrAnrudataH sarvAnmuhurmuhuravekShatI |
jagAmaiva mahAprAj~nA vanAya kRRitanishchayA
shlokas.32:
anvayuH pANDavAstAM tu sabhRRityAntaHpurAstadA |
tataH pramRRijya sAshrUNi putrAnvachanamabravIt

shlokas.1:
kuntyuvAcha||
evametanmahAbAho yathA vadasi pANDava |
kRRitamuddharShaNaM pUrvaM mayA vaH sIdatAM nRRipa
shlokas.2:
dyUtApahRRitarAjyAnAM patitAnAM sukhAdapi |
j~nAtibhiH paribhUtAnAM kRRitamuddharShaNaM mayA
shlokas.3:
kathaM pANDorna nashyeta santatiH puruSharShabhAH |
yashashcha vo na nashyeta iti choddharShaNaM kRRitam
shlokas.4:
yUyamindrasamAH sarve devatulyaparAkramAH |
mA pareShAM mukhaprekShAH sthetyevaM tatkRRitaM mayA
shlokas.5:
kathaM dharmabhRRitAM shreShTho rAjA tvaM vAsavopamaH |
punarvane na duHkhI syA iti choddharShaNaM kRRitam
shlokas.6:
nAgAyutasamaprANaH khyAtavikramapauruShaH |
nAyaM bhImo.atyayaM gachChediti choddharShaNaM kRRitam
shlokas.7:
bhImasenAdavarajastathAyaM vAsavopamaH |
vijayo nAvasIdeta iti choddharShaNaM kRRitam
shlokas.8:
nakulaH sahadevashcha tathemau guruvartinau |
kShudhA kathaM na sIdetAmiti choddharShaNaM kRRitam
shlokas.9:
iyaM cha bRRihatI shyAmA shrImatyAyatalochanA |
vRRithA sabhAtale kliShTA mA bhUditi cha tatkRRitam
shlokas.10:
prekShantyA me tadA hImAM vepantIM kadalImiva |
strIdharmiNImanindyA~NgIM tathA dyUtaparAjitAm
shlokas.11:
duHshAsano yadA mauDhyAddAsIvatparyakarShata |
tadaiva viditaM mahyaM parAbhUtamidaM kulam
shlokas.12:
viShaNNAH kuravashchaiva tadA me shvashurAdayaH |
yadaiShA nAthamichChantI vyalapatkurarI yathA
shlokas.13:
keshapakShe parAmRRiShTA pApena hatabuddhinA |
yadA duHshAsanenaiShA tadA muhyAmyahaM nRRipa
shlokas.14:
yuShmattejovivRRiddhyarthaM mayA hyuddharShaNaM kRRitam |
tadAnIM vidurAvAkyairiti tadvitta putrakAH
shlokas.15:
kathaM na rAjava.nsho.ayaM nashyetprApya sutAnmama |
pANDoriti mayA putra tasmAduddharShaNaM kRRitam
shlokas.16:
na tasya putraH pautrau vA kuta eva sa pArthiva |
labhate sukRRitA.NllokAnyasmAdva.nshaH praNashyati
shlokas.17:
bhuktaM rAjyaphalaM putrA bharturme vipulaM purA |
mahAdAnAni dattAni pItaH somo yathAvidhi
shlokas.18:
sAhaM nAtmaphalArthaM vai vAsudevamachUchudam |
vidurAyAH pralApaistaiH plAvanArthaM tu tatkRRitam
shlokas.19:
nAhaM rAjyaphalaM putra kAmaye putranirjitam |
patilokAnahaM puNyAnkAmaye tapasA vibho
shlokas.20:
shvashrUshvashurayoH kRRitvA shushrUShAM vanavAsinoH |
tapasA shoShayiShyAmi yudhiShThira kalevaram
shlokas.21:
nivartasva kurushreShTha bhImasenAdibhiH saha |
dharme te dhIyatAM buddhirmanaste mahadastu cha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
kuntyAstu vachanaM shrutvA pANDavA rAjasattama |
vrIDitAH saMnyavartanta pA~nchAlyA sahitAnaghAH
shlokas.2:
tataH shabdo mahAnAsItsarveShAmeva bhArata |
antaHpurANAM rudatAM dRRiShTvA kuntIM tathAgatAm
shlokas.3:
pradakShiNamathAvRRitya rAjAnaM pANDavAstadA |
abhivAdya nyavartanta pRRithAM tAmanivartya vai
shlokas.4:
tato.abravInmahArAjo dhRRitarAShTro.ambikAsutaH |
gAndhArIM viduraM chaiva samAbhAShya nigRRihya cha
shlokas.5:
yudhiShThirasya jananI devI sAdhu nivartyatAm |
yathA yudhiShThiraH prAha tatsarvaM satyameva hi
shlokas.6:
putraishvaryaM mahadidamapAsya cha mahAphalam |
kA nu gachChedvanaM durgaM putrAnutsRRijya mUDhavat
shlokas.7:
rAjyasthayA tapastaptaM dAnaM dattaM vrataM kRRitam |
anayA shakyamadyeha shrUyatAM cha vacho mama
shlokas.8:
gAndhAri parituShTo.asmi vadhvAH shushrUShaNena vai |
tasmAttvamenAM dharmaj~ne samanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.9:
ityuktA saubaleyI tu rAj~nA kuntImuvAcha ha |
tatsarvaM rAjavachanaM svaM cha vAkyaM visheShavat
shlokas.10:
na cha sA vanavAsAya devIM kRRitamatiM tadA |
shaknotyupAvartayituM kuntIM dharmaparAM satIm
shlokas.11:
tasyAstu taM sthiraM j~nAtvA vyavasAyaM kurustriyaH |
nivRRittA.nshcha kurushreShThAndRRiShTvA prarurudustadA
shlokas.12:
upAvRRitteShu pArtheShu sarveShvantaHpureShu cha |
yayau rAjA mahAprAj~no dhRRitarAShTro vanaM tadA
shlokas.13:
pANDavA api dInAste duHkhashokaparAyaNAH |
yAnaiH strIsahitAH sarve puraM pravivishustadA
shlokas.14:
tadahRRiShTamivAkUjaM gatotsavamivAbhavat |
nagaraM hAstinapuraM sastrIvRRiddhakumArakam
shlokas.15:
sarve chAsannirutsAhAH pANDavA jAtamanyavaH |
kuntyA hInAH suduHkhArtA vatsA iva vinAkRRitAH
shlokas.16:
dhRRitarAShTrastu tenAhnA gatvA sumahadantaram |
tato bhAgIrathItIre nivAsamakarotprabhuH
shlokas.17:
prAduShkRRitA yathAnyAyamagnayo vedapAragaiH |
vyarAjanta dvijashreShThaistatra tatra tapodhanaiH
prAduShkRRitAgnirabhavatsa cha vRRiddho narAdhipaH
shlokas.18:
sa rAjAgnInparyupAsya hutvA cha vidhivattadA |
sandhyAgataM sahasrA.nshumupAtiShThata bhArata
shlokas.19:
viduraH sa~njayashchaiva rAj~naH shayyAM kushaistataH |
chakratuH kuruvIrasya gAndhAryAshchAvidUrataH
shlokas.20:
gAndhAryAH saMnikarShe tu niShasAda kusheShvatha |
yudhiShThirasya jananI kuntI sAdhuvrate sthitA
shlokas.21:
teShAM sa.nshravaNe chApi niShedurvidurAdayaH |
yAjakAshcha yathoddeshaM dvijA ye chAnuyAyinaH
shlokas.22:
prAdhItadvijamukhyA sA samprajvAlitapAvakA |
babhUva teShAM rajanI brAhmIva prItivardhanI
shlokas.23:
tato rAtryAM vyatItAyAM kRRitapUrvAhNikakriyAH |
hutvAgniM vidhivatsarve prayayuste yathAkramam
uda~NmukhA nirIkShanta upavAsaparAyaNAH
shlokas.24:
sa teShAmatiduHkho.abhUnnivAsaH prathame.ahani |
shochatAM shochyamAnAnAM paurajAnapadairjanaiH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato bhAgIrathItIre medhye puNyajanochite |
nivAsamakarodrAjA vidurasya mate sthitaH
shlokas.2:
tatrainaM paryupAtiShThanbrAhmaNA rAShTravAsinaH |
kShatraviTshUdrasa~NghAshcha bahavo bharatarShabha
shlokas.3:
sa taiH parivRRito rAjA kathAbhirabhinandya tAn |
anujaj~ne sashiShyAnvai vidhivatpratipUjya cha
shlokas.4:
sAyAhne sa mahIpAlastato ga~NgAmupetya ha |
chakAra vidhivachChauchaM gAndhArI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.5:
tathaivAnye pRRithaksarve tIrtheShvAplutya bhArata |
chakruH sarvAH kriyAstatra puruShA vidurAdayaH
shlokas.6:
kRRitashauchaM tato vRRiddhaM shvashuraM kuntibhojajA |
gAndhArIM cha pRRithA rAjanga~NgAtIramupAnayat
shlokas.7:
rAj~nastu yAjakaistatra kRRito vedIparistaraH |
juhAva tatra vahniM sa nRRipatiH satyasa~NgaraH
shlokas.8:
tato bhAgIrathItIrAtkurukShetraM jagAma saH |
sAnugo nRRipatirvidvAnniyataH sa.nyatendriyaH
shlokas.9:
tatrAshramapadaM dhImAnabhigamya sa pArthivaH |
AsasAdAtha rAjarShiH shatayUpaM manIShiNam
shlokas.10:
sa hi rAjA mahAnAsItkekayeShu parantapaH |
sa putraM manujaishvarye niveshya vanamAvishat
shlokas.11:
tenAsau sahito rAjA yayau vyAsAshramaM tadA |
tatrainaM vidhivadrAjanpratyagRRihNAtkurUdvaham
shlokas.12:
sa dIkShAM tatra samprApya rAjA kauravanandanaH |
shatayUpAshrame tasminnivAsamakarottadA
shlokas.13:
tasmai sarvaM vidhiM rAjanrAjAchakhyau mahAmatiH |
AraNyakaM mahArAja vyAsasyAnumate tadA
shlokas.14:
evaM sa tapasA rAjA dhRRitarAShTro mahAmanAH |
yojayAmAsa chAtmAnaM tA.nshchApyanucharA.nstadA
shlokas.15:
tathaiva devI gAndhArI valkalAjinavAsinI |
kuntyA saha mahArAja samAnavratachAriNI
shlokas.16:
karmaNA manasA vAchA chakShuShA chApi te nRRipa |
saMniyamyendriyagrAmamAsthitAH paramaM tapaH
shlokas.17:
tvagasthibhUtaH parishuShkamA.nso; jaTAjinI valkalasa.nvRRitA~NgaH |
sa pArthivastatra tapashchachAra; maharShivattIvramapetadoShaH
shlokas.18:
kShattA cha dharmArthavidagryabuddhiH; sasa~njayastaM nRRipatiM sadAram |
upAcharadghoratapo jitAtmA; tadA kRRisho valkalachIravAsAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tatastasminmunishreShThA rAjAnaM draShTumabhyayuH |
nAradaH parvatashchaiva devalashcha mahAtapAH
shlokas.2:
dvaipAyanaH sashiShyashcha siddhAshchAnye manIShiNaH |
shatayUpashcha rAjarShirvRRiddhaH paramadhArmikaH
shlokas.3:
teShAM kuntI mahArAja pUjAM chakre yathAvidhi |
te chApi tutuShustasyAstApasAH paricharyayA
shlokas.4:
tatra dharmyAH kathAstAta chakruste paramarShayaH |
ramayanto mahAtmAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM janAdhipam
shlokas.5:
kathAntare tu kasmi.nshchiddevarShirnAradastadA |
kathAmimAmakathayatsarvapratyakShadarshivAn
shlokas.6:
purA prajApatisamo rAjAsIdakutobhayaH |
sahasrachitya ityuktaH shatayUpapitAmahaH
shlokas.7:
sa putre rAjyamAsajya jyeShThe paramadhArmike |
sahasrachityo dharmAtmA pravivesha vanaM nRRipaH
shlokas.8:
sa gatvA tapasaH pAraM dIptasya sa narAdhipaH |
pura.ndarasya sa.nsthAnaM pratipede mahAmanAH
shlokas.9:
dRRiShTapUrvaH sa bahusho rAjansampatatA mayA |
mahendrasadane rAjA tapasA dagdhakilbiShaH
shlokas.10:
tathA shailAlayo rAjA bhagadattapitAmahaH |
tapobalenaiva nRRipo mahendrasadanaM gataH
shlokas.11:
tathA pRRiShadhro nAmAsIdrAjA vajradharopamaH |
sa chApi tapasA lebhe nAkapRRiShThamito nRRipaH
shlokas.12:
asminnaraNye nRRipate mAndhAturapi chAtmajaH |
purukutso nRRipaH siddhiM mahatIM samavAptavAn
shlokas.13:
bhAryA samabhavadyasya narmadA saritAM varA |
so.asminnaraNye nRRipatistapastaptvA divaM gataH
shlokas.14:
shashalomA cha nAmAsIdrAjA paramadhArmikaH |
sa chApyasminvane taptvA tapo divamavAptavAn
shlokas.15:
dvaipAyanaprasAdAchcha tvamapIdaM tapovanam |
rAjannavApya duShprApAM siddhimagryAM gamiShyasi
shlokas.16:
tvaM chApi rAjashArdUla tapaso.ante shriyA vRRitaH |
gAndhArIsahito gantA gatiM teShAM mahAtmanAm
shlokas.17:
pANDuH smarati nityaM cha balahantuH samIpataH |
tvAM sadaiva mahIpAla sa tvAM shreyasi yokShyati
shlokas.18:
tava shushrUShayA chaiva gAndhAryAshcha yashasvinI |
bhartuH salokatAM kuntI gamiShyati vadhUstava
shlokas.19:
yudhiShThirasya jananI sa hi dharmaH sanAtanaH |
vayametatprapashyAmo nRRipate divyachakShuShA
shlokas.20:
pravekShyati mahAtmAnaM vidurashcha yudhiShThiram |
sa~njayastvadanudhyAnAtpUtaH svargamavApsyati
shlokas.21:
etachChrutvA kauravendro mahAtmA; sahaiva patnyA prItimAnpratyagRRihNAt |
vidvAnvAkyaM nAradasya prashasya; chakre pUjAM chAtulAM nAradAya
shlokas.22:
tathA sarve nAradaM viprasa~NghAH; sampUjayAmAsuratIva rAjan |
rAj~naH prItyA dhRRitarAShTrasya te vai; punaH punaH samahRRiShTAstadAnIm

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
nAradasya tu tadvAkyaM prashasha.nsurdvijottamAH |
shatayUpastu rAjarShirnAradaM vAkyamabravIt
shlokas.2:
aho bhagavatA shraddhA kururAjasya vardhitA |
sarvasya cha janasyAsya mama chaiva mahAdyute
shlokas.3:
asti kAchidvivakShA tu mama tAM gadataH shRRiNu |
dhRRitarAShTraM prati nRRipaM devarShe lokapUjita
shlokas.4:
sarvavRRittAntatattvaj~no bhavAndivyena chakShuShA |
yuktaH pashyasi devarShe gatIrvai vividhA nRRiNAm
shlokas.5:
uktavAnnRRipatInAM tvaM mahendrasya salokatAm |
na tvasya nRRipaterlokAH kathitAste mahAmune
shlokas.6:
sthAnamasya kShitipateH shrotumichChAmyahaM vibho |
tvattaH kIdRRikkadA veti tanmamAchakShva pRRichChataH
shlokas.7:
ityukto nAradastena vAkyaM sarvamanonugam |
vyAjahAra satAM madhye divyadarshI mahAtapAH
shlokas.8:
yadRRichChayA shakrasado gatvA shakraM shachIpatim |
dRRiShTavAnasmi rAjarShe tatra pANDuM narAdhipam
shlokas.9:
tatreyaM dhRRitarAShTrasya kathA samabhavannRRipa |
tapaso dushcharasyAsya yadayaM tapyate nRRipaH
shlokas.10:
tatrAhamidamashrauShaM shakrasya vadato nRRipa |
varShANi trINi shiShTAni rAj~no.asya paramAyuShaH
shlokas.11:
tataH kuberabhavanaM gAndhArIsahito nRRipaH |
vihartA dhRRitarAShTro.ayaM rAjarAjAbhipUjitaH
shlokas.12:
kAmagena vimAnena divyAbharaNabhUShitaH |
RRiShiputro mahAbhAgastapasA dagdhakilbiShaH
shlokas.13:
sa~nchariShyati lokA.nshcha devagandharvarakShasAm |
svachChandeneti dharmAtmA yanmAM tvaM paripRRichChasi
shlokas.14:
devaguhyamidaM prItyA mayA vaH kathitaM mahat |
bhavanto hi shrutadhanAstapasA dagdhakilbiShAH
shlokas.15:
iti te tasya tachChrutvA devarShermadhuraM vachaH |
sarve sumanasaH prItA babhUvuH sa cha pArthivaH
shlokas.16:
evaM kathAbhiranvAsya dhRRitarAShTraM manIShiNaH |
viprajagmuryathAkAmaM te siddhagatimAsthitAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
vanaM gate kauravendre duHkhashokasamAhatAH |
babhUvuH pANDavA rAjanmAtRRishokena chArditAH
shlokas.2:
tathA paurajanaH sarvaH shochannAste janAdhipam |
kurvANAshcha kathAstatra brAhmaNA nRRipatiM prati
shlokas.3:
kathaM nu rAjA vRRiddhaH sa vane vasati nirjane |
gAndhArI cha mahAbhAgA sA cha kuntI pRRithA katham
shlokas.4:
sukhArhaH sa hi rAjarShirna sukhaM tanmahAvanam |
kimavasthaH samAsAdya praj~nAchakShurhatAtmajaH
shlokas.5:
suduShkaraM kRRitavatI kuntI putrAnapashyatI |
rAjyashriyaM parityajya vanavAsamarochayat
shlokas.6:
viduraH kimavasthashcha bhrAtuH shushrUShurAtmavAn |
sa cha gAvalgaNirdhImAnbhartRRipiNDAnupAlakaH
shlokas.7:
AkumAraM cha paurAste chintAshokasamAhatAH |
tatra tatra kathAshchakruH samAsAdya parasparam
shlokas.8:
pANDavAshchaiva te sarve bhRRishaM shokaparAyaNAH |
shochanto mAtaraM vRRiddhAmUShurnAtichiraM pure
shlokas.9:
tathaiva pitaraM vRRiddhaM hataputraM janeshvaram |
gAndhArIM cha mahAbhAgAM viduraM cha mahAmatim
shlokas.10:
naiShAM babhUva samprItistAnvichintayatAM tadA |
na rAjye na cha nArIShu na vedAdhyayane tathA
shlokas.11:
paraM nirvedamagama.nshchintayanto narAdhipam |
tachcha j~nAtivadhaM ghoraM sa.nsmarantaH punaH punaH
shlokas.12:
abhimanyoshcha bAlasya vinAshaM raNamUrdhani |
karNasya cha mahAbAhoH sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinaH
shlokas.13:
tathaiva draupadeyAnAmanyeShAM suhRRidAmapi |
vadhaM sa.nsmRRitya te vIrA nAtipramanaso.abhavan
shlokas.14:
hatapravIrAM pRRithivIM hataratnAM cha bhArata |
sadaiva chintayantaste na nidrAmupalebhire
shlokas.15:
draupadI hataputrA cha subhadrA chaiva bhAminI |
nAtiprItiyute devyau tadAstAmaprahRRiShTavat
shlokas.16:
vairATyAstu sutaM dRRiShTvA pitaraM te parikShitam |
dhArayanti sma te prANA.nstava pUrvapitAmahAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM te puruShavyAghrAH pANDavA mAtRRinandanAH |
smaranto mAtaraM vIrA babhUvurbhRRishaduHkhitAH
shlokas.2:
ye rAjakAryeShu purA vyAsaktA nityasho.abhavan |
te rAjakAryANi tadA nAkArShuH sarvataH pure
shlokas.3:
AviShTA iva shokena nAbhyanandanta ki~nchana |
sambhAShyamANA api te na ki~nchitpratyapUjayan
shlokas.4:
te sma vIrA durAdharShA gAmbhIrye sAgaropamAH |
shokopahatavij~nAnA naShTasa~nj~nA ivAbhavan
shlokas.5:
anusmaranto jananIM tataste kurunandanAH |
kathaM nu vRRiddhamithunaM vahatyadya pRRithA kRRishA
shlokas.6:
kathaM cha sa mahIpAlo hataputro nirAshrayaH |
patnyA saha vasatyeko vane shvApadasevite
shlokas.7:
sA cha devI mahAbhAgA gAndhArI hatabAndhavA |
patimandhaM kathaM vRRiddhamanveti vijane vane
shlokas.8:
evaM teShAM kathayatAmautsukyamabhavattadA |
gamane chAbhavadbuddhirdhRRitarAShTradidRRikShayA
shlokas.9:
sahadevastu rAjAnaM praNipatyedamabravIt |
aho me bhavato dRRiShTaM hRRidayaM gamanaM prati
shlokas.10:
na hi tvA gauraveNAhamashakaM vaktumAtmanA |
gamanaM prati rAjendra tadidaM samupasthitam
shlokas.11:
diShTyA drakShyAmi tAM kuntIM vartayantIM tapasvinIm |
jaTilAM tApasIM vRRiddhAM kushakAshaparikShatAm
shlokas.12:
prAsAdaharmyasa.nvRRiddhAmatyantasukhabhAginIm |
kadA nu jananIM shrAntAM drakShyAmi bhRRishaduHkhitAm
shlokas.13:
anityAH khalu martyAnAM gatayo bharatarShabha |
kuntI rAjasutA yatra vasatyasukhinI vane
shlokas.14:
sahadevavachaH shrutvA draupadI yoShitAM varA |
uvAcha devI rAjAnamabhipUjyAbhinandya cha
shlokas.15:
kadA drakShyAmi tAM devIM yadi jIvati sA pRRithA |
jIvantyA hyadya naH prItirbhaviShyati narAdhipa
shlokas.16:
eShA te.astu matirnityaM dharme te ramatAM manaH |
yo.adya tvamasmAnrAjendra shreyasA yojayiShyasi
shlokas.17:
agrapAdasthitaM chemaM viddhi rAjanvadhUjanam |
kA~NkShantaM darshanaM kuntyA gAndhAryAH shvashurasya cha
shlokas.18:
ityuktaH sa nRRipo devyA pA~nchAlyA bharatarShabha |
senAdhyakShAnsamAnAyya sarvAnidamathAbravIt
shlokas.19:
niryAtayata me senAM prabhUtarathaku~njarAm |
drakShyAmi vanasa.nsthaM cha dhRRitarAShTraM mahIpatim
shlokas.20:
stryadhyakShA.nshchAbravIdrAjA yAnAni vividhAni me |
sajjIkriyantAM sarvANi shibikAshcha sahasrashaH
shlokas.21:
shakaTApaNaveshAshcha koshashilpina eva cha |
niryAntu koshapAlAshcha kurukShetrAshramaM prati
shlokas.22:
yashcha paurajanaH kashchiddraShTumichChati pArthivam |
anAvRRitaH suvihitaH sa cha yAtu surakShitaH
shlokas.23:
sUdAH paurogavAshchaiva sarvaM chaiva mahAnasam |
vividhaM bhakShyabhojyaM cha shakaTairuhyatAM mama
shlokas.24:
prayANaM ghuShyatAM chaiva shvobhUta iti mA chiram |
kriyantAM pathi chApyadya veshmAni vividhAni cha
shlokas.25:
evamAj~nApya rAjA sa bhrAtRRibhiH saha pANDavaH |
shvobhUte niryayau rAjA sastrIbAlapuraskRRitaH
shlokas.26:
sa bahirdivasAnevaM janaughaM paripAlayan |
nyavasannRRipatiH pa~ncha tato.agachChadvanaM prati

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
Aj~nApayAmAsa tataH senAM bharatasattamaH |
arjunapramukhairguptAM lokapAlopamairnaraiH
shlokas.2:
yogo yoga iti prItyA tataH shabdo mahAnabhUt |
kroshatAM sAdinAM tatra yujyatAM yujyatAmiti
shlokas.3:
kechidyAnairnarA jagmuH kechidashvairmanojavaiH |
rathaishcha nagarAkAraiH pradIptajvalanopamaiH
shlokas.4:
gajendraishcha tathaivAnye kechiduShTrairnarAdhipa |
padAtinastathaivAnye nakharaprAsayodhinaH
shlokas.5:
paurajAnapadAshchaiva yAnairbahuvidhaistathA |
anvayuH kururAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTradidRRikShayA
shlokas.6:
sa chApi rAjavachanAdAchAryo gautamaH kRRipaH |
senAmAdAya senAnI prayayAvAshramaM prati
shlokas.7:
tato dvijairvRRitaH shrImAnkururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
sa.nstUyamAno bahubhiH sUtamAgadhabandibhiH
shlokas.8:
pANDureNAtapatreNa dhriyamANena mUrdhani |
rathAnIkena mahatA niryayau kurunandanaH
shlokas.9:
gajaishchAchalasa~NkAshairbhImakarmA vRRikodaraH |
sajjayantrAyudhopetaiH prayayau mArutAtmajaH
shlokas.10:
mAdrIputrAvapi tathA hayArohaiH susa.nvRRitau |
jagmatuH prItijananau saMnaddhakavachadhvajau
shlokas.11:
arjunashcha mahAtejA rathenAdityavarchasA |
vashI shvetairhayairdivyairyuktenAnvagamannRRipam
shlokas.12:
draupadIpramukhAshchApi strIsa~NghAH shibikAgatAH |
stryadhyakShayuktAH prayayurvisRRijanto.amitaM vasu
shlokas.13:
samRRiddhanaranAgAshvaM veNuvINAninAditam |
shushubhe pANDavaM sainyaM tattadA bharatarShabha
shlokas.14:
nadItIreShu ramyeShu saratsu cha vishAM pate |
vAsAnkRRitvA krameNAtha jagmuste kurupu~NgavAH
shlokas.15:
yuyutsushcha mahAtejA dhaumyashchaiva purohitaH |
yudhiShThirasya vachanAtpuraguptiM prachakratuH
shlokas.16:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA kurukShetramavAtarat |
krameNottIrya yamunAM nadIM paramapAvanIm
shlokas.17:
sa dadarshAshramaM dUrAdrAjarShestasya dhImataH |
shatayUpasya kauravya dhRRitarAShTrasya chaiva ha
shlokas.18:
tataH pramuditaH sarvo janastadvanama~njasA |
vivesha sumahAnAdairApUrya bharatarShabha

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste pANDavA dUrAdavatIrya padAtayaH |
abhijagmurnarapaterAshramaM vinayAnatAH
shlokas.2:
sa cha paurajanaH sarvo ye cha rAShTranivAsinaH |
striyashcha kurumukhyAnAM padbhirevAnvayustadA
shlokas.3:
AshramaM te tato jagmurdhRRitarAShTrasya pANDavAH |
shUnyaM mRRigagaNAkIrNaM kadalIvanashobhitam
shlokas.4:
tatastatra samAjagmustApasA vividhavratAH |
pANDavAnAgatAndraShTuM kautUhalasamanvitAH
shlokas.5:
tAnapRRichChattato rAjA kvAsau kauravava.nshabhRRit |
pitA jyeShTho gato.asmAkamiti bAShpapariplutaH
shlokas.6:
tamUchuste tato vAkyaM yamunAmavagAhitum |
puShpANAmudakumbhasya chArthe gata iti prabho
shlokas.7:
tairAkhyAtena mArgeNa tataste prayayustadA |
dadRRishushchAvidUre tAnsarvAnatha padAtayaH
shlokas.8:
tataste satvarA jagmuH piturdarshanakA~NkShiNaH |
sahadevastu vegena prAdhAvadyena sA pRRithA
shlokas.9:
sasvanaM prarudandhImAnmAtuH pAdAvupaspRRishan |
sA cha bAShpAvilamukhI pradadarsha priyaM sutam
shlokas.10:
bAhubhyAM sampariShvajya samunnAmya cha putrakam |
gAndhAryAH kathayAmAsa sahadevamupasthitam
shlokas.11:
anantaraM cha rAjAnaM bhImasenamathArjunam |
nakulaM cha pRRithA dRRiShTvA tvaramANopachakrame
shlokas.12:
sA hyagre.agachChata tayordampatyorhataputrayoH |
karShantI tau tataste tAM dRRiShTvA saMnyapatanbhuvi
shlokas.13:
tAnrAjA svarayogena sparshena cha mahAmanAH |
pratyabhij~nAya medhAvI samAshvAsayata prabhuH
shlokas.14:
tataste bAShpamutsRRijya gAndhArIsahitaM nRRipam |
upatasthurmahAtmAno mAtaraM cha yathAvidhi
shlokas.15:
sarveShAM toyakalashA~njagRRihuste svayaM tadA |
pANDavA labdhasa~nj~nAste mAtrA chAshvAsitAH punaH
shlokas.16:
tato nAryo nRRisiMhAnAM sa cha yodhajanastadA |
paurajAnapadAshchaiva dadRRishustaM narAdhipam
shlokas.17:
nivedayAmAsa tadA janaM taM nAmagotrataH |
yudhiShThiro narapatiH sa chainAnpratyapUjayat
shlokas.18:
sa taiH parivRRito mene harShabAShpAvilekShaNaH |
rAjAtmAnaM gRRihagataM pureva gajasAhvaye
shlokas.19:
abhivAdito vadhUbhishcha kRRiShNAdyAbhiH sa pArthivaH |
gAndhAryA sahito dhImAnkuntyA cha pratyanandata
shlokas.20:
tatashchAshramamAgachChatsiddhachAraNasevitam |
didRRikShubhiH samAkIrNaM nabhastArAgaNairiva

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
sa taiH saha naravyAghrairbhrAtRRibhirbharatarShabha |
rAjA ruchirapadmAkShairAsAM chakre tadAshrame
shlokas.2:
tApasaishcha mahAbhAgairnAnAdeshasamAgataiH |
draShTuM kurupateH putrAnpANDavAnpRRithuvakShasaH
shlokas.3:
te.abruva~nj~nAtumichChAmaH katamo.atra yudhiShThiraH |
bhImArjunayamAshchaiva draupadI cha yashasvinI
shlokas.4:
tAnAchakhyau tadA sUtaH sarvAnnAmAbhinAmataH |
sa~njayo draupadIM chaiva sarvAshchAnyAH kurustriyaH
shlokas.5:
ya eSha jAmbUnadashuddhagaura;tanurmahAsiMha iva pravRRiddhaH |
prachaNDaghoNaH pRRithudIrghanetra;stAmrAyatAsyaH kururAja eShaH
shlokas.6:
ayaM punarmattagajendragAmI; prataptachAmIkarashuddhagauraH |
pRRithvAyatA.nsaH pRRithudIrghabAhu;rvRRikodaraH pashyata pashyatainam
shlokas.7:
yastveSha pArshve.asya mahAdhanuShmA;~nshyAmo yuvA vAraNayUthapAbhaH |
siMhonnatA.nso gajakhelagAmI; padmAyatAkSho.arjuna eSha vIraH
shlokas.8:
kuntIsamIpe puruShottamau tu; yamAvimau viShNumahendrakalpau |
manuShyaloke sakale samo.asti; yayorna rUpe na bale na shIle
shlokas.9:
iyaM punaH padmadalAyatAkShI; madhyaM vayaH ki~nchidiva spRRishantI |
nIlotpalAbhA puradevateva; kRRiShNA sthitA mUrtimatIva lakShmIH
shlokas.10:
asyAstu pArshve kanakottamAbhA; yaiShA prabhA mUrtimatIva gaurI |
madhye sthitaiShA bhaginI dvijAgryA; chakrAyudhasyApratimasya tasya
shlokas.11:
iyaM svasA rAjachamUpatestu; pravRRiddhanIlotpaladAmavarNA |
paspardha kRRiShNena nRRipaH sadA yo; vRRikodarasyaiSha parigraho.agryaH
shlokas.12:
iyaM cha rAj~no magadhAdhipasya; sutA jarAsandha iti shrutasya |
yavIyaso mAdravatIsutasya; bhAryA matA champakadAmagaurI
shlokas.13:
indIvarashyAmatanuH sthitA tu; yaiShAparAsannamahItale cha |
bhAryA matA mAdravatIsutasya; jyeShThasya seyaM kamalAyatAkShI
shlokas.14:
iyaM tu niShTaptasuvarNagaurI; rAj~no virATasya sutA saputrA |
bhAryAbhimanyornihato raNe yo; droNAdibhistairviratho rathasthaiH
shlokas.15:
etAstu sImantashiroruhA yAH; shuklottarIyA nararAjapatnyaH |
rAj~no.asya vRRiddhasya para.nshatAkhyAH; snuShA vivIrA hataputranAthAH
shlokas.16:
etA yathAmukhyamudAhRRitA vo; brAhmaNyabhAvAdRRijubuddhisattvAH |
sarvA bhavadbhiH paripRRichChyamAnA; narendrapatnyaH suvishuddhasattvAH
shlokas.17:
evaM sa rAjA kuruvRRiddhavaryaH; samAgatastairnaradevaputraiH |
paprachCha sarvAnkushalaM tadAnIM; gateShu sarveShvatha tApaseShu
shlokas.18:
yodheShu chApyAshramamaNDalaM taM; muktvA niviShTeShu vimuchya patram |
strIvRRiddhabAle cha susaMniviShTe; yathArhataH kushalaM paryapRRichChat

shlokas.1:
dhRRitarAShTra uvAcha||
yudhiShThira mahAbAho kachchittAta kushalyasi |
sahito bhrAtRRibhiH sarvaiH paurajAnapadaistathA
shlokas.2:
ye cha tvAmupajIvanti kachchitte.api nirAmayAH |
sachivA bhRRityavargAshcha guravashchaiva te vibho
shlokas.3:
kachchidvartasi paurANIM vRRittiM rAjarShisevitAm |
kachchiddAyAnanuchChidya koshaste.abhiprapUryate
shlokas.4:
arimadhyasthamitreShu vartase chAnurUpataH |
brAhmaNAnagrahArairvA yathAvadanupashyasi
shlokas.5:
kachchitte parituShyanti shIlena bharatarShabha |
shatravo guravaH paurA bhRRityA vA svajano.api vA
shlokas.6:
kachchidyajasi rAjendra shraddhAvAnpitRRidevatAH |
atithI.nshchAnnapAnena kachchidarchasi bhArata
shlokas.7:
kachchichcha viShaye viprAH svakarmaniratAstava |
kShatriyA vaishyavargA vA shUdrA vApi kuTumbinaH
shlokas.8:
kachchitstrIbAlavRRiddhaM te na shochati na yAchate |
jAmayaH pUjitAH kachchittava gehe nararShabha
shlokas.9:
kachchidrAjarShiva.nsho.ayaM tvAmAsAdya mahIpatim |
yathochitaM mahArAja yashasA nAvasIdati
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
ityeva.nvAdinaM taM sa nyAyavitpratyabhAShata |
kushalaprashnasa.nyuktaM kushalo vAkyakarmaNi
shlokas.11:
kachchitte vardhate rAja.nstapo mandashramasya te |
api me jananI cheyaM shushrUShurvigataklamA
apyasyAH saphalo rAjanvanavAso bhaviShyati
shlokas.12:
iyaM cha mAtA jyeShThA me vItavAtAdhvakarshitA |
ghoreNa tapasA yuktA devI kachchinna shochati
shlokas.13:
hatAnputrAnmahAvIryAnkShatradharmaparAyaNAn |
nApadhyAyati vA kachchidasmAnpApakRRitaH sadA
shlokas.14:
kva chAsau viduro rAjannainaM pashyAmahe vayam |
sa~njayaH kushalI chAyaM kachchinnu tapasi sthitaH
shlokas.15:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM dhRRitarAShTro janAdhipam |
kushalI viduraH putra tapo ghoraM samAsthitaH
shlokas.16:
vAyubhakSho nirAhAraH kRRisho dhamanisantataH |
kadAchiddRRishyate vipraiH shUnye.asminkAnane kvachit
shlokas.17:
ityevaM vadatastasya jaTI vITAmukhaH kRRishaH |
digvAsA maladigdhA~Ngo vanareNusamukShitaH
shlokas.18:
dUrAdAlakShitaH kShattA tatrAkhyAto mahIpateH |
nivartamAnaH sahasA janaM dRRiShTvAshramaM prati
shlokas.19:
tamanvadhAvannRRipatireka eva yudhiShThiraH |
pravishantaM vanaM ghoraM lakShyAlakShyaM kvachitkvachit
shlokas.20:
bho bho vidura rAjAhaM dayitaste yudhiShThiraH |
iti bruvannarapatistaM yatnAdabhyadhAvata
shlokas.21:
tato vivikta ekAnte tasthau buddhimatAM varaH |
viduro vRRikShamAshritya ka~nchittatra vanAntare
shlokas.22:
taM rAjA kShINabhUyiShThamAkRRitImAtrasUchitam |
abhijaj~ne mahAbuddhiM mahAbuddhiryudhiShThiraH
shlokas.23:
yudhiShThiro.ahamasmIti vAkyamuktvAgrataH sthitaH |
vidurasyAshrave rAjA sa cha pratyAha sa~nj~nayA
shlokas.24:
tataH so.animiSho bhUtvA rAjAnaM samudaikShata |
sa.nyojya vidurastasmindRRiShTiM dRRiShTyA samAhitaH
shlokas.25:
vivesha viduro dhImAngAtrairgAtrANi chaiva ha |
prANAnprANeShu cha dadhadindriyANIndriyeShu cha
shlokas.26:
sa yogabalamAsthAya vivesha nRRipatestanum |
viduro dharmarAjasya tejasA prajvalanniva
shlokas.27:
vidurasya sharIraM tattathaiva stabdhalochanam |
vRRikShAshritaM tadA rAjA dadarsha gatachetanam
shlokas.28:
balavantaM tathAtmAnaM mene bahuguNaM tadA |
dharmarAjo mahAtejAstachcha sasmAra pANDavaH
shlokas.29:
paurANamAtmanaH sarvaM vidyAvAnsa vishAM pate |
yogadharmaM mahAtejA vyAsena kathitaM yathA
shlokas.30:
dharmarAjastu tatrainaM sa~nchaskArayiShustadA |
dagdhukAmo.abhavadvidvAnatha vai vAgabhAShata
shlokas.31:
bho bho rAjanna dagdhavyametadvidurasa~nj~nakam |
kalevaramihaitatte dharma eSha sanAtanaH
shlokas.32:
lokAH santAnakA nAma bhaviShyantyasya pArthiva |
yatidharmamavApto.asau naiva shochyaH parantapa
shlokas.33:
ityukto dharmarAjaH sa vinivRRitya tataH punaH |
rAj~no vaichitravIryasya tatsarvaM pratyavedayat
shlokas.34:
tataH sa rAjA dyutimAnsa cha sarvo janastadA |
bhImasenAdayashchaiva paraM vismayamAgatAH
shlokas.35:
tachChrutvA prItimAnrAjA bhUtvA dharmajamabravIt |
Apo mUlaM phalaM chaiva mamedaM pratigRRihyatAm
shlokas.36:
yadanno hi naro rAja.nstadanno.asyAtithiH smRRitaH |
ityuktaH sa tathetyeva prAha dharmAtmajo nRRipam
phalaM mUlaM cha bubhuje rAj~nA dattaM sahAnujaH
shlokas.37:
tataste vRRikShamUleShu kRRitavAsaparigrahAH |
tAM rAtriM nyavasansarve phalamUlajalAshanAH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
evaM sA rajanI teShAmAshrame puNyakarmaNAm |
shivA nakShatrasampannA sA vyatIyAya bhArata
shlokas.2:
tatra tatra kathAshchAsa.nsteShAM dharmArthalakShaNAH |
vichitrapadasa~nchArA nAnAshrutibhiranvitAH
shlokas.3:
pANDavAstvabhito mAturdharaNyAM suShupustadA |
utsRRijya sumahArhANi shayanAni narAdhipa
shlokas.4:
yadAhAro.abhavadrAjA dhRRitarAShTro mahAmanAH |
tadAhArA nRRivIrAste nyavasa.nstAM nishAM tadA
shlokas.5:
vyatItAyAM tu sharvaryAM kRRitapUrvAhNikakriyaH |
bhrAtRRibhiH saha kaunteyo dadarshAshramamaNDalam
shlokas.6:
sAntaHpuraparIvAraH sabhRRityaH sapurohitaH |
yathAsukhaM yathoddeshaM dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nayA
shlokas.7:
dadarsha tatra vedIshcha samprajvalitapAvakAH |
kRRitAbhiShekairmunibhirhutAgnibhirupasthitAH
shlokas.8:
vAneyapuShpanikarairAjyadhUmodgamairapi |
brAhmeNa vapuShA yuktA yuktA munigaNaishcha tAH
shlokas.9:
mRRigayUthairanudvignaistatra tatra samAshritaiH |
asha~NkitaiH pakShigaNaiH pragItairiva cha prabho
shlokas.10:
kekAbhirnIlakaNThAnAM dAtyUhAnAM cha kUjitaiH |
kokilAnAM cha kuharaiH shubhaiH shrutimanoharaiH
shlokas.11:
prAdhItadvijaghoShaishcha kvachitkvachidala~NkRRitam |
phalamUlasamudvAhairmahadbhishchopashobhitam
shlokas.12:
tataH sa rAjA pradadau tApasArthamupAhRRitAn |
kalashAnkA~nchanAnrAja.nstathaivaudumbarAnapi
shlokas.13:
ajinAni praveNIshcha sruksruvaM cha mahIpatiH |
kamaNDalU.nstathA sthAlIH piTharANi cha bhArata
shlokas.14:
bhAjanAni cha lauhAni pAtrIshcha vividhA nRRipa |
yadyadichChati yAvachcha yadanyadapi kA~NkShitam
shlokas.15:
evaM sa rAjA dharmAtmA parItyAshramamaNDalam |
vasu vishrANya tatsarvaM punarAyAnmahIpatiH
shlokas.16:
kRRitAhnikaM cha rAjAnaM dhRRitarAShTraM manIShiNam |
dadarshAsInamavyagraM gAndhArIsahitaM tadA
shlokas.17:
mAtaraM chAvidUrasthAM shiShyavatpraNatAM sthitAm |
kuntIM dadarsha dharmAtmA satataM dharmachAriNIm
shlokas.18:
sa tamabhyarchya rAjAnaM nAma sa.nshrAvya chAtmanaH |
niShIdetyabhyanuj~nAto bRRisyAmupavivesha ha
shlokas.19:
bhImasenAdayashchaiva pANDavAH kauravarShabham |
abhivAdyopasa~NgRRihya niSheduH pArthivAj~nayA
shlokas.20:
sa taiH parivRRito rAjA shushubhe.atIva kauravaH |
bibhradbrAhmIM shriyaM dIptAM devairiva bRRihaspatiH
shlokas.21:
tathA teShUpaviShTeShu samAjagmurmaharShayaH |
shatayUpaprabhRRitayaH kurukShetranivAsinaH
shlokas.22:
vyAsashcha bhagavAnvipro devarShigaNapUjitaH |
vRRitaH shiShyairmahAtejA darshayAmAsa taM nRRipam
shlokas.23:
tataH sa rAjA kauravyaH kuntIputrashcha vIryavAn |
