bhImasenAdayashchaiva samutthAyAbhyapUjayan
shlokas.25:
navaM tu viShTaraM kaushyaM kRRiShNAjinakushottaram |
pratipede tadA vyAsastadarthamupakalpitam
shlokas.26:
te cha sarve dvijashreShThA viShTareShu samantataH |
dvaipAyanAbhyanuj~nAtA niShedurvipulaujasaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tathA samupaviShTeShu pANDaveShu mahAtmasu |
vyAsaH satyavatIputraH provAchAmantrya pArthivam
shlokas.2:
dhRRitarAShTra mahAbAho kachchitte vardhate tapaH |
kachchinmanaste prINAti vanavAse narAdhipa
shlokas.3:
kachchiddhRRidi na te shoko rAjanputravinAshajaH |
kachchijj~nAnAni sarvANi prasannAni tavAnagha
shlokas.4:
kachchidbuddhiM dRRiDhAM kRRitvA charasyAraNyakaM vidhim |
kachchidvadhUshcha gAndhArI na shokenAbhibhUyate
shlokas.5:
mahApraj~nA buddhimatI devI dharmArthadarshinI |
AgamApAyatattvaj~nA kachchideShA na shochati
shlokas.6:
kachchitkuntI cha rAja.nstvAM shushrUShuranaha~NkRRitA |
yA parityajya rAjyaM svaM gurushushrUShaNe ratA
shlokas.7:
kachchiddharmasuto rAjA tvayA prItyAbhinanditaH |
bhImArjunayamAshchaiva kachchidete.api sAntvitAH
shlokas.8:
kachchinnandasi dRRiShTvaitAnkachchitte nirmalaM manaH |
kachchidvishuddhabhAvo.asi jAtaj~nAno narAdhipa
shlokas.9:
etaddhi tritayaM shreShThaM sarvabhUteShu bhArata |
nirvairatA mahArAja satyamadroha eva cha
shlokas.10:
kachchitte nAnutApo.asti vanavAsena bhArata |
svadate vanyamannaM vA munivAsA.nsi vA vibho
shlokas.11:
viditaM chApi me rAjanvidurasya mahAtmanaH |
gamanaM vidhinA yena dharmasya sumahAtmanaH
shlokas.12:
mANDavyashApAddhi sa vai dharmo viduratAM gataH |
mahAbuddhirmahAyogI mahAtmA sumahAmanAH
shlokas.13:
bRRihaspatirvA deveShu shukro vApyasureShu yaH |
na tathA buddhisampanno yathA sa puruSharShabhaH
shlokas.14:
tapobalavyayaM kRRitvA sumahachchirasambhRRitam |
mANDavyenarShiNA dharmo hyabhibhUtaH sanAtanaH
shlokas.15:
niyogAdbrahmaNaH pUrvaM mayA svena balena cha |
vaichitravIryake kShetre jAtaH sa sumahAmatiH
shlokas.16:
bhrAtA tava mahArAja devadevaH sanAtanaH |
dhAraNAchChreyaso dhyAnAdyaM dharmaM kavayo viduH
shlokas.17:
satyena sa.nvardhayati damena niyamena cha |
ahi.nsayA cha dAnena tapasA cha sanAtanaH
shlokas.18:
yena yogabalAjjAtaH kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
dharma ityeSha nRRipate prAj~nenAmitabuddhinA
shlokas.19:
yathA hyagniryathA vAyuryathApaH pRRithivI yathA |
yathAkAshaM tathA dharma iha chAmutra cha sthitaH
shlokas.20:
sarvagashchaiva kauravya sarvaM vyApya charAcharam |
dRRishyate devadevaH sa siddhairnirdagdhakilbiShaiH
shlokas.21:
yo hi dharmaH sa viduro viduro yaH sa pANDavaH |
sa eSha rAjanvashyaste pANDavaH preShyavatsthitaH
shlokas.22:
praviShTaH sa svamAtmAnaM bhrAtA te buddhisattamaH |
diShTyA mahAtmA kaunteyaM mahAyogabalAnvitaH
shlokas.23:
tvAM chApi shreyasA yokShye nachirAdbharatarShabha |
sa.nshayachChedanArthaM hi prAptaM mAM viddhi putraka
shlokas.24:
na kRRitaM yatpurA kaishchitkarma loke maharShibhiH |
AshcharyabhUtaM tapasaH phalaM sa.ndarshayAmi vaH
shlokas.25:
kimichChasi mahIpAla mattaH prAptumamAnuSham |
draShTuM spraShTumatha shrotuM vada kartAsmi tattathA

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
vanavAsaM gate vipra dhRRitarAShTre mahIpatau |
sabhArye nRRipashArdUle vadhvA kuntyA samanvite
shlokas.2:
vidure chApi sa.nsiddhe dharmarAjaM vyapAshrite |
vasatsu pANDuputreShu sarveShvAshramamaNDale
shlokas.3:
yattadAshcharyamiti vai kariShyAmItyuvAcha ha |
vyAsaH paramatejasvI maharShistadvadasva me
shlokas.4:
vanavAse cha kauravyaH kiyantaM kAlamachyutaH |
yudhiShThiro narapatirnyavasatsajano dvija
shlokas.5:
kimAhArAshcha te tatra sasainyA nyavasanprabho |
sAntaHpurA mahAtmAna iti tadbrUhi me.anagha
shlokas.6:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
te.anuj~nAtAstadA rAjankururAjena pANDavAH |
vividhAnyannapAnAni vishrAmyAnubhavanti te
shlokas.7:
mAsamekaM vijahruste sasainyAntaHpurA vane |
atha tatrAgamadvyAso yathoktaM te mayAnagha
shlokas.8:
tathA tu teShAM sarveShAM kathAbhirnRRipasaMnidhau |
vyAsamanvAsatAM rAjannAjagmurmunayo.apare
shlokas.9:
nAradaH parvatashchaiva devalashcha mahAtapAH |
vishvAvasustumburushcha chitrasenashcha bhArata
shlokas.10:
teShAmapi yathAnyAyaM pUjAM chakre mahAmanAH |
dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nAtaH kururAjo yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.11:
niSheduste tataH sarve pUjAM prApya yudhiShThirAt |
AsaneShvatha puNyeShu barhiShkeShu vareShu cha
shlokas.12:
teShu tatropaviShTeShu sa tu rAjA mahAmatiH |
pANDuputraiH parivRRito niShasAda kurUdvahaH
shlokas.13:
gAndhArI chaiva kuntI cha draupadI sAtvatI tathA |
striyashchAnyAstathAnyAbhiH sahopavivishustataH
shlokas.14:
teShAM tatra kathA divyA dharmiShThAshchAbhavannRRipa |
RRiShINAM cha purANAnAM devAsuravimishritAH
shlokas.15:
tataH kathAnte vyAsastaM praj~nAchakShuShamIshvaram |
provAcha vadatAM shreShThaH punareva sa tadvachaH
prIyamANo mahAtejAH sarvavedavidAM varaH
shlokas.16:
viditaM mama rAjendra yatte hRRidi vivakShitam |
dahyamAnasya shokena tava putrakRRitena vai
shlokas.17:
gAndhAryAshchaiva yadduHkhaM hRRidi tiShThati pArthiva |
kuntyAshcha yanmahArAja draupadyAshcha hRRidi sthitam
shlokas.18:
yachcha dhArayate tIvraM duHkhaM putravinAshajam |
subhadrA kRRiShNabhaginI tachchApi viditaM mama
shlokas.19:
shrutvA samAgamamimaM sarveShAM vastato nRRipa |
sa.nshayachChedanAyAhaM prAptaH kauravanandana
shlokas.20:
ime cha devagandharvAH sarve chaiva maharShayaH |
pashyantu tapaso vIryamadya me chirasambhRRitam
shlokas.21:
taduchyatAM mahAbAho kaM kAmaM pradishAmi te |
pravaNo.asmi varaM dAtuM pashya me tapaso balam
shlokas.22:
evamuktaH sa rAjendro vyAsenAmitabuddhinA |
muhUrtamiva sa~nchintya vachanAyopachakrame
shlokas.23:
dhanyo.asmyanugRRihIto.asmi saphalaM jIvitaM cha me |
yanme samAgamo.adyeha bhavadbhiH saha sAdhubhiH
shlokas.25:
darshanAdeva bhavatAM pUto.ahaM nAtra sa.nshayaH |
vidyate na bhayaM chApi paralokAnmamAnaghAH
shlokas.26:
kiM tu tasya sudurbuddhermandasyApanayairbhRRisham |
dUyate me mano nityaM smarataH putragRRiddhinaH
shlokas.27:
apApAH pANDavA yena nikRRitAH pApabuddhinA |
ghAtitA pRRithivI cheyaM sahasA sanaradvipA
shlokas.28:
rAjAnashcha mahAtmAno nAnAjanapadeshvarAH |
Agamya mama putrArthe sarve mRRityuvashaM gatAH
shlokas.29:
ye te putrA.nshcha dArAshcha prANA.nshcha manasaH priyAn |
parityajya gatAH shUrAH pretarAjaniveshanam
shlokas.30:
kA nu teShAM gatirbrahmanmitrArthe ye hatA mRRidhe |
tathaiva putrapautrANAM mama ye nihatA yudhi
shlokas.31:
dUyate me mano.abhIkShNaM ghAtayitvA mahAbalam |
bhIShmaM shAntanavaM vRRiddhaM droNaM cha dvijasattamam
shlokas.32:
mama putreNa mUDhena pApena suhRRidadviShA |
kShayaM nItaM kulaM dIptaM pRRithivIrAjyamichChatA
shlokas.33:
etatsarvamanusmRRitya dahyamAno divAnisham |
na shAntimadhigachChAmi duHkhashokasamAhataH
iti me chintayAnasya pitaH sharma na vidyate

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tachChrutvA vividhaM tasya rAjarSheH paridevitam |
punarnavIkRRitaH shoko gAndhAryA janamejaya
shlokas.2:
kuntyA drupadaputryAshcha subhadrAyAstathaiva cha |
tAsAM cha varanArINAM vadhUnAM kauravasya ha
shlokas.3:
putrashokasamAviShTA gAndhArI tvidamabravIt |
shvashuraM baddhanayanA devI prA~njalirutthitA
shlokas.4:
ShoDashemAni varShANi gatAni munipu~Ngava |
asya rAj~no hatAnputrA~nshochato na shamo vibho
shlokas.5:
putrashokasamAviShTo niHshvasanhyeSha bhUmipaH |
na shete vasatIH sarvA dhRRitarAShTro mahAmune
shlokas.6:
lokAnanyAnsamartho.asi sraShTuM sarvA.nstapobalAt |
kimu lokAntaragatAnrAj~no darshayituM sutAn
shlokas.7:
iyaM cha draupadI kRRiShNA hataj~nAtisutA bhRRisham |
shochatyatIva sAdhvI te snuShANAM dayitA snuShA
shlokas.8:
tathA kRRiShNasya bhaginI subhadrA bhadrabhAShiNI |
saubhadravadhasantaptA bhRRishaM shochati bhAminI
shlokas.9:
iyaM cha bhUrishravaso bhAryA paramaduHkhitA |
bhartRRivyasanashokArtA na shete vasatIH prabho
shlokas.10:
yasyAstu shvashuro dhImAnbAhlIkaH sa kurUdvahaH |
nihataH somadattashcha pitrA saha mahAraNe
shlokas.11:
shrImachchAsya mahAbuddheH sa~NgrAmeShvapalAyinaH |
putrasya te putrashataM nihataM yadraNAjire
shlokas.12:
tasya bhAryAshatamidaM putrashokasamAhatam |
punaH punarvardhayAnaM shokaM rAj~no mamaiva cha
tenArambheNa mahatA mAmupAste mahAmune
shlokas.13:
ye cha shUrA mahAtmAnaH shvashurA me mahArathAH |
somadattaprabhRRitayaH kA nu teShAM gatiH prabho
shlokas.14:
tava prasAdAdbhagavanvishoko.ayaM mahIpatiH |
kuryAtkAlamahaM chaiva kuntI cheyaM vadhUstava
shlokas.15:
ityuktavatyAM gAndhAryAM kuntI vratakRRishAnanA |
prachChannajAtaM putraM taM sasmArAdityasambhavam
shlokas.16:
tAmRRiShirvarado vyAso dUrashravaNadarshanaH |
apashyadduHkhitAM devIM mAtaraM savyasAchinaH
shlokas.17:
tAmuvAcha tato vyAso yatte kAryaM vivakShitam |
tadbrUhi tvaM mahAprAj~ne yatte manasi vartate
shlokas.18:
tataH kuntI shvashurayoH praNamya shirasA tadA |
uvAcha vAkyaM savrIDaM vivRRiNvAnA purAtanam

shlokas.1:
kuntyuvAcha||
bhagava~nshvashuro me.asi daivatasyApi daivatam |
sa me devAtidevastvaM shRRiNu satyAM giraM mama
shlokas.2:
tapasvI kopano vipro durvAsA nAma me pituH |
bhikShAmupAgato bhoktuM tamahaM paryatoShayam
shlokas.3:
shauchena tvAgasastyAgaiH shuddhena manasA tathA |
kopasthAneShvapi mahatsvakupyaM na kadAchana
shlokas.4:
sa me varamadAtprItaH kRRitamityahamabruvam |
avashyaM te grahItavyamiti mAM so.abravIdvachaH
shlokas.5:
tataH shApabhayAdvipramavochaM punareva tam |
evamastviti cha prAha punareva sa mAM dvijaH
shlokas.6:
dharmasya jananI bhadre bhavitrI tvaM varAnane |
vashe sthAsyanti te devA yA.nstvamAvAhayiShyasi
shlokas.7:
ityuktvAntarhito viprastato.ahaM vismitAbhavam |
na cha sarvAsvavasthAsu smRRitirme vipraNashyati
shlokas.8:
atha harmyatalasthAhaM ravimudyantamIkShatI |
sa.nsmRRitya tadRRiShervAkyaM spRRihayantI divAkaram
sthitAhaM bAlabhAvena tatra doShamabudhyatI
shlokas.9:
atha devaH sahasrA.nshurmatsamIpagato.abhavat |
dvidhA kRRitvAtmano dehaM bhUmau cha gagane.api cha
tatApa lokAnekena dvitIyenAgamachcha mAm
shlokas.10:
sa mAmuvAcha vepantIM varaM matto vRRiNIShva ha |
gamyatAmiti taM chAhaM praNamya shirasAvadam
shlokas.11:
sa mAmuvAcha tigmA.nshurvRRithAhvAnaM na te kShamam |
dhakShyAmi tvAM cha vipraM cha yena datto varastava
shlokas.12:
tamahaM rakShatI vipraM shApAdanaparAdhinam |
putro me tvatsamo deva bhavediti tato.abruvam
shlokas.13:
tato mAM tejasAvishya mohayitvA cha bhAnumAn |
uvAcha bhavitA putrastavetyabhyagamaddivam
shlokas.14:
tato.ahamantarbhavane piturvRRittAntarakShiNI |
gUDhotpannaM sutaM bAlaM jale karNamavAsRRijam
shlokas.15:
nUnaM tasyaiva devasya prasAdAtpunareva tu |
kanyAhamabhavaM vipra yathA prAha sa mAmRRiShiH
shlokas.16:
sa mayA mUDhayA putro j~nAyamAno.apyupekShitaH |
tanmAM dahati viprarShe yathA suviditaM tava
shlokas.17:
yadi pApamapApaM vA tadetadvivRRitaM mayA |
tanme bhayaM tvaM bhagavanvyapanetumihArhasi
shlokas.18:
yachchAsya rAj~no viditaM hRRidisthaM bhavato.anagha |
taM chAyaM labhatAM kAmamadyaiva munisattama
shlokas.19:
ityuktaH pratyuvAchedaM vyAso vedavidAM varaH |
sAdhu sarvamidaM tathyamevameva yathAttha mAm
shlokas.20:
aparAdhashcha te nAsti kanyAbhAvaM gatA hyasi |
devAshchaishvaryavanto vai sharIrANyAvishanti vai
shlokas.21:
santi devanikAyAshcha sa~NkalpAjjanayanti ye |
vAchA dRRiShTyA tathA sparshAtsa~NgharSheNeti pa~nchadhA
shlokas.22:
manuShyadharmo daivena dharmeNa na hi yujyate |
iti kunti vyajAnIhi vyetu te mAnaso jvaraH
shlokas.23:
sarvaM balavatAM pathyaM sarvaM balavatAM shuchi |
sarvaM balavatAM dharmaH sarvaM balavatAM svakam

shlokas.1:
vyAsa uvAcha||
bhadre drakShyasi gAndhAri putrAnbhrAtR^InsakhI.nstathA |
vadhUshcha patibhiH sArdhaM nishi suptotthitA iva
shlokas.2:
karNaM drakShyati kuntI cha saubhadraM chApi yAdavI |
draupadI pa~ncha putrA.nshcha pitR^InbhrAtR^I.nstathaiva cha
shlokas.3:
pUrvamevaiSha hRRidaye vyavasAyo.abhavanmama |
yathAsmi chodito rAj~nA bhavatyA pRRithayaiva cha
shlokas.4:
na te shochyA mahAtmAnaH sarva eva nararShabhAH |
kShatradharmaparAH santastathA hi nidhanaM gatAH
shlokas.5:
bhavitavyamavashyaM tatsurakAryamanindite |
avaterustataH sarve devabhAgairmahItalam
shlokas.6:
gandharvApsarasashchaiva pishAchA guhyarAkShasAH |
tathA puNyajanAshchaiva siddhA devarShayo.api cha
shlokas.7:
devAshcha dAnavAshchaiva tathA brahmarShayo.amalAH |
ta ete nidhanaM prAptAH kurukShetre raNAjire
shlokas.8:
gandharvarAjo yo dhImAndhRRitarAShTra iti shrutaH |
sa eva mAnuShe loke dhRRitarAShTraH patistava
shlokas.9:
pANDuM marudgaNaM viddhi vishiShTatamamachyutam |
dharmasyA.nsho.abhavatkShattA rAjA chAyaM yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.10:
kaliM duryodhanaM viddhi shakuniM dvAparaM tathA |
duHshAsanAdInviddhi tvaM rAkShasA~nshubhadarshane
shlokas.11:
marudgaNAdbhImasenaM balavantamari.ndamam |
viddhi cha tvaM naramRRiShimimaM pArthaM dhana~njayam
nArAyaNaM hRRiShIkeshamashvinau yamajAvubhau
shlokas.12:
dvidhA kRRitvAtmano dehamAdityaM tapatAM varam |
lokA.nshcha tApayAnaM vai viddhi karNaM cha shobhane
yashcha vairArthamudbhUtaH sa~NgharShajananastathA
shlokas.13:
yashcha pANDavadAyAdo hataH ShaDbhirmahArathaiH |
sa soma iha saubhadro yogAdevAbhavaddvidhA
shlokas.14:
draupadyA saha sambhUtaM dhRRiShTadyumnaM cha pAvakAt |
agnerbhAgaM shubhaM viddhi rAkShasaM tu shikhaNDinam
shlokas.15:
droNaM bRRihaspaterbhAgaM viddhi drauNiM cha rudrajam |
bhIShmaM cha viddhi gA~NgeyaM vasuM mAnuShatAM gatam
shlokas.16:
evamete mahAprAj~ne devA mAnuShyametya hi |
tataH punargatAH svargaM kRRite karmaNi shobhane
shlokas.17:
yachcha vo hRRidi sarveShAM duHkhamenachchiraM sthitam |
tadadya vyapaneShyAmi paralokakRRitAdbhayAt
shlokas.18:
sarve bhavanto gachChantu nadIM bhAgIrathIM prati |
tatra drakShyatha tAnsarvAnye hatAsminraNAjire
shlokas.19:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
iti vyAsasya vachanaM shrutvA sarvo janastadA |
mahatA siMhanAdena ga~NgAmabhimukho yayau
shlokas.20:
dhRRitarAShTrashcha sAmAtyaH prayayau saha pANDavaiH |
sahito munishArdUlairgandharvaishcha samAgataiH
shlokas.21:
tato ga~NgAM samAsAdya krameNa sa janArNavaH |
nivAsamakarotsarvo yathAprIti yathAsukham
shlokas.22:
rAjA cha pANDavaiH sArdhamiShTe deshe sahAnugaH |
nivAsamakaroddhImAnsastrIvRRiddhapuraHsaraH
shlokas.23:
jagAma tadahashchApi teShAM varShashataM yathA |
nishAM pratIkShamANAnAM didRRikShUNAM mRRitAnnRRipAn
shlokas.24:
atha puNyaM girivaramastamabhyagamadraviH |
tataH kRRitAbhiShekAste naishaM karma samAcharan

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tato nishAyAM prAptAyAM kRRitasAyAhnikakriyAH |
vyAsamabhyagamansarve ye tatrAsansamAgatAH
shlokas.2:
dhRRitarAShTrastu dharmAtmA pANDavaiH sahitastadA |
shuchirekamanAH sArdhamRRiShibhistairupAvishat
shlokas.3:
gAndhAryA saha nAryastu sahitAH samupAvishan |
paurajAnapadashchApi janaH sarvo yathAvayaH
shlokas.4:
tato vyAso mahAtejAH puNyaM bhAgIrathIjalam |
avagAhyAjuhAvAtha sarvA.NllokAnmahAmuniH
shlokas.5:
pANDavAnAM cha ye yodhAH kauravANAM cha sarvashaH |
rAjAnashcha mahAbhAgA nAnAdeshanivAsinaH
shlokas.6:
tataH sutumulaH shabdo jalAntarjanamejaya |
prAdurAsIdyathA pUrvaM kurupANDavasenayoH
shlokas.7:
tataste pArthivAH sarve bhIShmadroNapurogamAH |
sasainyAH salilAttasmAtsamuttasthuH sahasrashaH
shlokas.8:
virATadrupadau chobhau saputrau sahasainikau |
draupadeyAshcha saubhadro rAkShasashcha ghaTotkachaH
shlokas.9:
karNaduryodhanau chobhau shakunishcha mahArathaH |
duHshAsanAdayashchaiva dhArtarAShTrA mahArathAH
shlokas.10:
jArAsandhirbhagadatto jalasandhashcha pArthivaH |
bhUrishravAH shalaH shalyo vRRiShasenashcha sAnujaH
shlokas.11:
lakShmaNo rAjaputrashcha dhRRiShTadyumnasya chAtmajAH |
shikhaNDiputrAH sarve cha dhRRiShTaketushcha sAnujaH
shlokas.12:
achalo vRRiShakashchaiva rAkShasashchApyalAyudhaH |
bAhlIkaH somadattashcha chekitAnashcha pArthivaH
shlokas.13:
ete chAnye cha bahavo bahutvAdye na kIrtitAH |
sarve bhAsuradehAste samuttasthurjalAttataH
shlokas.14:
yasya vIrasya yo veSho yo dhvajo yachcha vAhanam |
tena tena vyadRRishyanta samupetA narAdhipAH
shlokas.15:
divyAmbaradharAH sarve sarve bhrAjiShNukuNDalAH |
nirvairA niraha~NkArA vigatakrodhamanyavaH
shlokas.16:
gandharvairupagIyantaH stUyamAnAshcha bandibhiH |
divyamAlyAmbaradharA vRRitAshchApsarasAM gaNaiH
shlokas.17:
dhRRitarAShTrasya cha tadA divyaM chakShurnarAdhipa |
muniH satyavatIputraH prItaH prAdAttapobalAt
shlokas.18:
divyaj~nAnabalopetA gAndhArI cha yashasvinI |
dadarsha putrA.nstAnsarvAnye chAnye.api raNe hatAH
shlokas.19:
tadadbhutamachintyaM cha sumahadromaharShaNam |
vismitaH sa janaH sarvo dadarshAnimiShekShaNaH
shlokas.20:
tadutsavamadodagraM hRRiShTanArInarAkulam |
dadRRishe balamAyAntaM chitraM paTagataM yathA
shlokas.21:
dhRRitarAShTrastu tAnsarvAnpashyandivyena chakShuShA |
mumude bharatashreShTha prasAdAttasya vai muneH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataste bharatashreShThAH samAjagmuH parasparam |
vigatakrodhamAtsaryAH sarve vigatakalmaShAH
shlokas.2:
vidhiM paramamAsthAya brahmarShivihitaM shubham |
samprItamanasaH sarve devaloka ivAmarAH
shlokas.3:
putraH pitrA cha mAtrA cha bhAryA cha patinA saha |
bhrAtA bhrAtrA sakhA chaiva sakhyA rAjansamAgatAH
shlokas.4:
pANDavAstu maheShvAsaM karNaM saubhadrameva cha |
sampraharShAtsamAjagmurdraupadeyA.nshcha sarvashaH
shlokas.5:
tataste prIyamANA vai karNena saha pANDavAH |
sametya pRRithivIpAlAH sauhRRide.avasthitAbhavan
shlokas.6:
RRiShiprasAdAtte.anye cha kShatriyA naShTamanyavaH |
asauhRRidaM parityajya sauhRRide paryavasthitAH
shlokas.7:
evaM samAgatAH sarve gurubhirbAndhavaistathA |
putraishcha puruShavyAghrAH kuravo.anye cha mAnavAH
shlokas.8:
tAM rAtrimekAM kRRitsnAM te vihRRitya prItamAnasAH |
menire paritoSheNa nRRipAH svargasado yathA
shlokas.9:
nAtra shoko bhayaM trAso nAratirnAyasho.abhavat |
parasparaM samAgamya yodhAnAM bharatarShabha
shlokas.10:
samAgatAstAH pitRRibhirbhrAtRRibhiH patibhiH sutaiH |
mudaM paramikAM prApya nAryo duHkhamathAtyajan
shlokas.11:
ekAM rAtriM vihRRityaivaM te vIrAstAshcha yoShitaH |
AmantryAnyonyamAshliShya tato jagmuryathAgatam
shlokas.12:
tato visarjayAmAsa lokA.nstAnmunipu~NgavaH |
kShaNenAntarhitAshchaiva prekShatAmeva te.abhavan
shlokas.13:
avagAhya mahAtmAnaH puNyAM tripathagAM nadIm |
sarathAH sadhvajAshchaiva svAni sthAnAni bhejire
shlokas.14:
devalokaM yayuH kechitkechidbrahmasadastathA |
kechichcha vAruNaM lokaM kechitkauberamApnuvan
shlokas.15:
tathA vaivasvataM lokaM kechichchaivApnuvannRRipAH |
rAkShasAnAM pishAchAnAM kechichchApyuttarAnkurUn
shlokas.16:
vichitragatayaH sarve yA avApyAmaraiH saha |
Ajagmuste mahAtmAnaH savAhAH sapadAnugAH
shlokas.17:
gateShu teShu sarveShu salilastho mahAmuniH |
dharmashIlo mahAtejAH kurUNAM hitakRRitsadA
tataH provAcha tAH sarvAH kShatriyA nihateshvarAH
shlokas.18:
yA yAH patikRRitA.NllokAnichChanti paramastriyaH |
tA jAhnavIjalaM kShipramavagAhantvatandritAH
shlokas.19:
tatastasya vachaH shrutvA shraddadhAnA varA~NganAH |
shvashuraM samanuj~nApya vivishurjAhnavIjalam
shlokas.20:
vimuktA mAnuShairdehaistatastA bhartRRibhiH saha |
samAjagmustadA sAdhvyaH sarvA eva vishAM pate
shlokas.21:
evaM krameNa sarvAstAH shIlavatyaH kulastriyaH |
pravishya toyaM nirmuktA jagmurbhartRRisalokatAm
shlokas.22:
divyarUpasamAyuktA divyAbharaNabhUShitAH |
divyamAlyAmbaradharA yathAsAM patayastathA
shlokas.23:
tAH shIlasattvasampannA vitamaskA gataklamAH |
sarvAH sarvaguNairyuktAH svaM svaM sthAnaM prapedire
shlokas.24:
yasya yasya cha yaH kAmastasminkAle.abhavattadA |
taM taM visRRiShTavAnvyAso varado dharmavatsalaH
shlokas.25:
tachChrutvA naradevAnAM punarAgamanaM narAH |
jahRRiShurmuditAshchAsannanyadehagatA api
shlokas.26:
priyaiH samAgamaM teShAM ya imaM shRRiNuyAnnaraH |
priyANi labhate nityamiha cha pretya chaiva ha
shlokas.28:
svAdhyAyayuktAH puruShAH kriyAyuktAshcha bhArata |
adhyAtmayogayuktAshcha dhRRitimantashcha mAnavAH
shrutvA parva tvidaM nityamavApsyanti parAM gatim

shlokas.1:
sUta uvAcha||
etachChrutvA nRRipo vidvAnhRRiShTo.abhUjjanamejayaH |
pitAmahAnAM sarveShAM gamanAgamanaM tadA
shlokas.2:
abravIchcha mudA yuktaH punarAgamanaM prati |
kathaM nu tyaktadehAnAM punastadrUpadarshanam
shlokas.3:
ityuktaH sa dvijashreShTho vyAsashiShyaH pratApavAn |
provAcha vadatAM shreShThastaM nRRipaM janamejayam
shlokas.4:
avipraNAshaH sarveShAM karmaNAmiti nishchayaH |
karmajAni sharIrANi tathaivAkRRitayo nRRipa
shlokas.5:
mahAbhUtAni nityAni bhUtAdhipatisa.nshrayAt |
teShAM cha nityasa.nvAso na vinAsho viyujyatAm
shlokas.6:
anAshAya kRRitaM karma tasya cheShTaH phalAgamaH |
AtmA chaibhiH samAyuktaH sukhaduHkhamupAshnute
shlokas.7:
avinAshI tathA nityaM kShetraj~na iti nishchayaH |
bhUtAnAmAtmabhAvo yo dhruvo.asau sa.nvijAnatAm
shlokas.8:
yAvanna kShIyate karma tAvadasya svarUpatA |
sa~NkShINakarmA puruSho rUpAnyatvaM niyachChati
shlokas.9:
nAnAbhAvAstathaikatvaM sharIraM prApya saMhatAH |
bhavanti te tathA nityAH pRRithagbhAvaM vijAnatAm
shlokas.10:
ashvamedhe shrutishcheyamashvasa~nj~napanaM prati |
lokAntaragatA nityaM prANA nityA hi vAjinaH
shlokas.11:
ahaM hitaM vadAmyetatpriyaM chettava pArthiva |
devayAnA hi panthAnaH shrutAste yaj~nasa.nstare
shlokas.12:
sukRRito yatra te yaj~nastatra devA hitAstava |
yadA samanvitA devAH pashUnAM gamaneshvarAH
gatimantashcha teneShTvA nAnye nityA bhavanti te
shlokas.13:
nitye.asminpa~nchake varge nitye chAtmani yo naraH |
asya nAnAsamAyogaM yaH pashyati vRRithAmatiH
viyoge shochate.atyarthaM sa bAla iti me matiH
shlokas.14:
viyoge doShadarshI yaH sa.nyogamiha varjayet |
asa~Nge sa~Ngamo nAsti duHkhaM bhuvi viyogajam
shlokas.15:
parAparaj~nastu naro nAbhimAnAdudIritaH |
aparaj~naH parAM buddhiM spRRiShTvA mohAdvimuchyate
shlokas.16:
adarshanAdApatitaH punashchAdarshanaM gataH |
nAhaM taM vedmi nAsau mAM na cha me.asti virAgatA
shlokas.17:
yena yena sharIreNa karotyayamanIshvaraH |
tena tena sharIreNa tadavashyamupAshnute
mAnasaM manasApnoti shArIraM cha sharIravAn

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
adRRiShTvA tu nRRipaH putrAndarshanaM pratilabdhavAn |
RRiShiprasAdAtputrANAM svarUpANAM kurUdvaha
shlokas.2:
sa rAjA rAjadharmA.nshcha brahmopaniShadaM tathA |
avAptavAnnarashreShTho buddhinishchayameva cha
shlokas.3:
vidurashcha mahAprAj~no yayau siddhiM tapobalAt |
dhRRitarAShTraH samAsAdya vyAsaM chApi tapasvinam
shlokas.4:
janamejaya uvAcha||
mamApi varado vyAso darshayetpitaraM yadi |
tadrUpaveShavayasaM shraddadhyAM sarvameva te
shlokas.5:
priyaM me syAtkRRitArthashcha syAmahaM kRRitanishchayaH |
prasAdAdRRiShiputrasya mama kAmaH samRRidhyatAm
shlokas.6:
sUta uvAcha||
ityuktavachane tasminnRRipe vyAsaH pratApavAn |
prasAdamakaroddhImAnAnayachcha parikShitam
shlokas.7:
tatastadrUpavayasamAgataM nRRipatiM divaH |
shrImantaM pitaraM rAjA dadarsha janamejayaH
shlokas.8:
shamIkaM cha mahAtmAnaM putraM taM chAsya shRRi~NgiNam |
amAtyA ye babhUvushcha rAj~nastA.nshcha dadarsha ha
shlokas.9:
tataH so.avabhRRithe rAjA mudito janamejayaH |
pitaraM snApayAmAsa svayaM sasnau cha pArthivaH
shlokas.10:
snAtvA cha bharatashreShThaH so.a.astIkamidamabravIt |
yAyAvarakulotpannaM jaratkArusutaM tadA
shlokas.11:
AstIka vividhAshcharyo yaj~no.ayamiti me matiH |
yadadyAyaM pitA prApto mama shokapraNAshanaH
shlokas.12:
AstIka uvAcha||
RRiShirdvaipAyano yatra purANastapaso nidhiH |
yaj~ne kurukulashreShTha tasya lokAvubhau jitau
shlokas.13:
shrutaM vichitramAkhyAnaM tvayA pANDavanandana |
sarpAshcha bhasmasAnnItA gatAshcha padavIM pituH
shlokas.14:
katha~nchittakShako muktaH satyatvAttava pArthiva |
RRiShayaH pUjitAH sarve gatiM dRRiShTvA mahAtmanaH
shlokas.15:
prAptaH suvipulo dharmaH shrutvA pApavinAshanam |
vimukto hRRidayagranthirudArajanadarshanAt
shlokas.16:
ye cha pakShadharA dharme sadvRRittaruchayashcha ye |
yAndRRiShTvA hIyate pApaM tebhyaH kAryA namaskriyAH
shlokas.17:
sUta uvAcha||
etachChrutvA dvijashreShThAtsa rAjA janamejayaH |
pUjayAmAsa tamRRiShimanumAnya punaH punaH
shlokas.18:
paprachCha tamRRiShiM chApi vaishampAyanamachyutam |
kathAvasheShaM dharmaj~no vanavAsasya sattama

shlokas.1:
janamejaya uvAcha||
dRRiShTvA putrA.nstathA pautrAnsAnubandhA~njanAdhipaH |
dhRRitarAShTraH kimakarodrAjA chaiva yudhiShThiraH
shlokas.2:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
taddRRiShTvA mahadAshcharyaM putrANAM darshanaM punaH |
vItashokaH sa rAjarShiH punarAshramamAgamat
shlokas.3:
itarastu janaH sarvaste chaiva paramarShayaH |
pratijagmuryathAkAmaM dhRRitarAShTrAbhyanuj~nayA
shlokas.4:
pANDavAstu mahAtmAno laghubhUyiShThasainikAH |
anujagmurmahAtmAnaM sadAraM taM mahIpatim
shlokas.5:
tamAshramagataM dhImAnbrahmarShirlokapUjitaH |
muniH satyavatIputro dhRRitarAShTramabhAShata
shlokas.6:
dhRRitarAShTra mahAbAho shRRiNu kauravanandana |
shrutaM te j~nAnavRRiddhAnAmRRiShINAM puNyakarmaNAm
shlokas.7:
RRiddhAbhijanavRRiddhAnAM vedavedA~NgavedinAm |
dharmaj~nAnAM purANAnAM vadatAM vividhAH kathAH
shlokas.8:
mA sma shoke manaH kArShIrdiShTena vyathate budhaH |
shrutaM devarahasyaM te nAradAddevadarshanAt
shlokas.9:
gatAste kShatradharmeNa shastrapUtAM gatiM shubhAm |
yathA dRRiShTAstvayA putrA yathAkAmavihAriNaH
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThirastvayaM dhImAnbhavantamanurudhyate |
sahito bhrAtRRibhiH sarvaiH sadAraH sasuhRRijjanaH
shlokas.11:
visarjayainaM yAtveSha svarAjyamanushAsatAm |
mAsaH samadhiko hyeShAmatIto vasatAM vane
shlokas.12:
etaddhi nityaM yatnena padaM rakShyaM parantapa |
bahupratyarthikaM hyetadrAjyaM nAma narAdhipa
shlokas.13:
ityuktaH kauravo rAjA vyAsenAmitabuddhinA |
yudhiShThiramathAhUya vAgmI vachanamabravIt
shlokas.14:
ajAtashatro bhadraM te shRRiNu me bhrAtRRibhiH saha |
tvatprasAdAnmahIpAla shoko nAsmAnprabAdhate
shlokas.15:
rame chAhaM tvayA putra pureva gajasAhvaye |
nAthenAnugato vidvanpriyeShu parivartinA
shlokas.16:
prAptaM putraphalaM tvattaH prItirme vipulA tvayi |
na me manyurmahAbAho gamyatAM putra mA chiram
shlokas.17:
bhavantaM cheha samprekShya tapo me parihIyate |
tapoyuktaM sharIraM cha tvAM dRRiShTvA dhAritaM punaH
shlokas.18:
mAtarau te tathaiveme shIrNaparNakRRitAshane |
mama tulyavrate putra nachiraM vartayiShyataH
shlokas.19:
duryodhanaprabhRRitayo dRRiShTA lokAntaraM gatAH |
vyAsasya tapaso vIryAdbhavatashcha samAgamAt
shlokas.20:
prayojanaM chiraM vRRittaM jIvitasya cha me.anagha |
ugraM tapaH samAsthAsye tvamanuj~nAtumarhasi
shlokas.21:
tvayyadya piNDaH kIrtishcha kulaM chedaM pratiShThitam |
shvo vAdya vA mahAbAho gamyatAM putra mA chiram
shlokas.22:
rAjanItiH subahushaH shrutA te bharatarShabha |
sa.ndeShTavyaM na pashyAmi kRRitametAvatA vibho
shlokas.23:
ityuktavachanaM tAta nRRipo rAjAnamabravIt |
na mAmarhasi dharmaj~na parityaktumanAgasam
shlokas.24:
kAmaM gachChantu me sarve bhrAtaro.anucharAstathA |
bhavantamahamanviShye mAtarau cha yatavrate
shlokas.25:
tamuvAchAtha gAndhArI maivaM putra shRRiNuShva me |
tvayyadhInaM kurukulaM piNDashcha shvashurasya me
shlokas.26:
gamyatAM putra paryAptametAvatpUjitA vayam |
rAjA yadAha tatkAryaM tvayA putra piturvachaH
shlokas.27:
ityuktaH sa tu gAndhAryA kuntImidamuvAcha ha |
snehabAShpAkule netre pramRRijya rudatIM vachaH
shlokas.28:
visarjayati mAM rAjA gAndhArI cha yashasvinI |
bhavatyAM baddhachittastu kathaM yAsyAmi duHkhitaH
shlokas.29:
na chotsahe tapovighnaM kartuM te dharmachAriNi |
tapaso hi paraM nAsti tapasA vindate mahat
shlokas.30:
mamApi na tathA rAj~ni rAjye buddhiryathA purA |
tapasyevAnuraktaM me manaH sarvAtmanA tathA
shlokas.31:
shUnyeyaM cha mahI sarvA na me prItikarI shubhe |
bAndhavA naH parikShINA balaM no na yathA purA
shlokas.32:
pA~nchAlAH subhRRishaM kShINAH kanyAmAtrAvasheShitAH |
na teShAM kulakartAraM ka~nchitpashyAmyahaM shubhe
shlokas.33:
sarve hi bhasmasAnnItA droNenaikena sa.nyuge |
avasheShAstu nihatA droNaputreNa vai nishi
shlokas.34:
chedayashchaiva matsyAshcha dRRiShTapUrvAstathaiva naH |
kevalaM vRRiShNichakraM tu vAsudevaparigrahAt
yaM dRRiShTvA sthAtumichChAmi dharmArthaM nAnyahetukam
shlokas.35:
shivena pashya naH sarvAndurlabhaM darshanaM tava |
bhaviShyatyamba rAjA hi tIvramArapsyate tapaH
shlokas.36:
etachChrutvA mahAbAhuH sahadevo yudhAM patiH |
yudhiShThiramuvAchedaM bAShpavyAkulalochanaH
shlokas.37:
notsahe.ahaM parityaktuM mAtaraM pArthivarShabha |
pratiyAtu bhavAnkShipraM tapastapsyAmyahaM vane
shlokas.38:
ihaiva shoShayiShyAmi tapasAhaM kalevaram |
pAdashushrUShaNe yukto rAj~no mAtrostathAnayoH
shlokas.39:
tamuvAcha tataH kuntI pariShvajya mahAbhujam |
gamyatAM putra maiva tvaM vochaH kuru vacho mama
shlokas.40:
AgamA vaH shivAH santu svasthA bhavata putrakAH |
uparodho bhavedevamasmAkaM tapasaH kRRite
shlokas.41:
tvatsnehapAshabaddhA cha hIyeyaM tapasaH parAt |
tasmAtputraka gachCha tvaM shiShTamalpaM hi naH prabho
shlokas.42:
evaM sa.nstambhitaM vAkyaiH kuntyA bahuvidhairmanaH |
sahadevasya rAjendra rAj~nashchaiva visheShataH
shlokas.43:
te mAtrA samanuj~nAtA rAj~nA cha kurupu~NgavAH |
abhivAdya kurushreShThamAmantrayitumArabhan
shlokas.44:
rAjanpratigamiShyAmaH shivena pratinanditAH |
anuj~nAtAstvayA rAjangamiShyAmo vikalmaShAH
shlokas.45:
evamuktaH sa rAjarShirdharmarAj~nA mahAtmanA |
anujaj~ne jayAshIrbhirabhinandya yudhiShThiram
shlokas.46:
bhImaM cha balinAM shreShThaM sAntvayAmAsa pArthivaH |
sa chAsya samya~NmedhAvI pratyapadyata vIryavAn
shlokas.47:
arjunaM cha samAshliShya yamau cha puruSharShabhau |
anujaj~ne sa kauravyaH pariShvajyAbhinandya cha
shlokas.48:
gAndhAryA chAbhyanuj~nAtAH kRRitapAdAbhivandanAH |
jananyA samupAghrAtAH pariShvaktAshcha te nRRipam
chakruH pradakShiNaM sarve vatsA iva nivAraNe
shlokas.49:
punaH punarnirIkShantaH prajagmuste pradakShiNam |
tathaiva draupadI sAdhvI sarvAH kauravayoShitaH
shlokas.50:
nyAyataH shvashure vRRittiM prayujya prayayustataH |
shvashrUbhyAM samanuj~nAtAH pariShvajyAbhinanditAH
sa.ndiShTAshchetikartavyaM prayayurbhartRRibhiH saha
shlokas.51:
tataH prajaj~ne ninadaH sUtAnAM yujyatAmiti |
uShTrANAM kroshatAM chaiva hayAnAM heShatAmapi
shlokas.52:
tato yudhiShThiro rAjA sadAraH sahasainikaH |
nagaraM hAstinapuraM punarAyAtsabAndhavaH

shlokas.1:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
dvivarShopanivRRitteShu pANDaveShu yadRRichChayA |
devarShirnArado rAjannAjagAma yudhiShThiram
shlokas.2:
tamabhyarchya mahAbAhuH kururAjo yudhiShThiraH |
AsInaM parivishvastaM provAcha vadatAM varaH
shlokas.3:
chirasya khalu pashyAmi bhagavantamupasthitam |
kachchitte kushalaM vipra shubhaM vA pratyupasthitam
shlokas.4:
ke deshAH paridRRiShTAste kiM cha kAryaM karomi te |
tadbrUhi dvijamukhya tvamasmAkaM cha priyo.atithiH
shlokas.5:
nArada uvAcha||
chiradRRiShTo.asi me rAjannAgato.asmi tapovanAt |
paridRRiShTAni tIrthAni ga~NgA chaiva mayA nRRipa
shlokas.6:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
vadanti puruShA me.adya ga~NgAtIranivAsinaH |
dhRRitarAShTraM mahAtmAnamAsthitaM paramaM tapaH
shlokas.7:
api dRRiShTastvayA tatra kushalI sa kurUdvahaH |
gAndhArI cha pRRithA chaiva sUtaputrashcha sa~njayaH
shlokas.8:
kathaM cha vartate chAdya pitA mama sa pArthivaH |
shrotumichChAmi bhagavanyadi dRRiShTastvayA nRRipaH
shlokas.9:
nArada uvAcha||
sthirIbhUya mahArAja shRRiNu sarvaM yathAtatham |
yathA shrutaM cha dRRiShTaM cha mayA tasmi.nstapovane
shlokas.10:
vanavAsanivRRitteShu bhavatsu kurunandana |
kurukShetrAtpitA tubhyaM ga~NgAdvAraM yayau nRRipa
shlokas.11:
gAndhAryA sahito dhImAnvadhvA kuntyA samanvitaH |
sa~njayena cha sUtena sAgnihotraH sayAjakaH
shlokas.12:
Atasthe sa tapastIvraM pitA tava tapodhanaH |
vITAM mukhe samAdhAya vAyubhakSho.abhavanmuniH
shlokas.13:
vane sa munibhiH sarvaiH pUjyamAno mahAtapAH |
tvagasthimAtrasheShaH sa ShaNmAsAnabhavannRRipaH
shlokas.14:
gAndhArI tu jalAhArA kuntI mAsopavAsinI |
sa~njayaH ShaShThabhaktena vartayAmAsa bhArata
shlokas.15:
agnI.nstu yAjakAstatra juhuvurvidhivatprabho |
dRRishyato.adRRishyatashchaiva vane tasminnRRipasya ha
shlokas.16:
aniketo.atha rAjA sa babhUva vanagocharaH |
te chApi sahite devyau sa~njayashcha tamanvayuH
shlokas.17:
sa~njayo nRRipaternetA sameShu viShameShu cha |
gAndhAryAstu pRRithA rAja.nshchakShurAsIdaninditA
shlokas.18:
tataH kadAchidga~NgAyAH kachChe sa nRRipasattamaH |
ga~NgAyAmApluto dhImAnAshramAbhimukho.abhavat
shlokas.19:
atha vAyuH samudbhUto dAvAgnirabhavanmahAn |
dadAha tadvanaM sarvaM parigRRihya samantataH
shlokas.20:
dahyatsu mRRigayUtheShu dvijihveShu samantataH |
varAhANAM cha yUtheShu sa.nshrayatsu jalAshayAn
shlokas.21:
samAviddhe vane tasminprApte vyasana uttame |
nirAhAratayA rAjA mandaprANavicheShTitaH
asamartho.apasaraNe sukRRishau mAtarau cha te
shlokas.22:
tataH sa nRRipatirdRRiShTvA vahnimAyAntamantikAt |
idamAha tataH sUtaM sa~njayaM pRRithivIpate
shlokas.23:
gachCha sa~njaya yatrAgnirna tvAM dahati karhichit |
vayamatrAgninA yuktA gamiShyAmaH parAM gatim
shlokas.24:
tamuvAcha kilodvignaH sa~njayo vadatAM varaH |
rAjanmRRityuraniShTo.ayaM bhavitA te vRRithAgninA
shlokas.25:
na chopAyaM prapashyAmi mokShaNe jAtavedasaH |
yadatrAnantaraM kAryaM tadbhavAnvaktumarhati
shlokas.26:
ityuktaH sa~njayenedaM punarAha sa pArthivaH |
naiSha mRRityuraniShTo no niHsRRitAnAM gRRihAtsvayam
shlokas.27:
jalamagnistathA vAyuratha vApi vikarshanam |
tApasAnAM prashasyante gachCha sa~njaya mAchiram
shlokas.28:
ityuktvA sa~njayaM rAjA samAdhAya manastadA |
prA~NmukhaH saha gAndhAryA kuntyA chopAvishattadA
shlokas.29:
sa~njayastaM tathA dRRiShTvA pradakShiNamathAkarot |
uvAcha chainaM medhAvI yu~NkShvAtmAnamiti prabho
shlokas.30:
RRiShiputro manIShI sa rAjA chakre.asya tadvachaH |
saMnirudhyendriyagrAmamAsItkAShThopamastadA
shlokas.31:
gAndhArI cha mahAbhAgA jananI cha pRRithA tava |
dAvAgninA samAyukte sa cha rAjA pitA tava
shlokas.32:
sa~njayastu mahAmAtrastasmAddAvAdamuchyata |
ga~NgAkUle mayA dRRiShTastApasaiH parivAritaH
shlokas.33:
sa tAnAmantrya tejasvI nivedyaitachcha sarvashaH |
prayayau sa~njayaH sUto himavantaM mahIdharam
shlokas.34:
evaM sa nidhanaM prAptaH kururAjo mahAmanAH |
gAndhArI cha pRRithA chaiva jananyau te narAdhipa
shlokas.35:
yadRRichChayAnuvrajatA mayA rAj~naH kalevaram |
tayoshcha devyorubhayordRRiShTAni bharatarShabha
shlokas.36:
tatastapovane tasminsamAjagmustapodhanAH |
shrutvA rAj~nastathA niShThAM na tvashochangatiM cha te
shlokas.37:
tatrAshrauShamahaM sarvametatpuruShasattama |
yathA cha nRRipatirdagdho devyau te cheti pANDava
shlokas.38:
na shochitavyaM rAjendra svantaH sa pRRithivIpatiH |
prAptavAnagnisa.nyogaM gAndhArI jananI cha te
shlokas.39:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
etachChrutvA tu sarveShAM pANDavAnAM mahAtmanAm |
niryANaM dhRRitarAShTrasya shokaH samabhavanmahAn
shlokas.40:
antaHpurANAM cha tadA mahAnArtasvaro.abhavat |
paurANAM cha mahArAja shrutvA rAj~nastadA gatim
shlokas.41:
aho dhigiti rAjA tu vikrushya bhRRishaduHkhitaH |
UrdhvabAhuH smaranmAtuH praruroda yudhiShThiraH
bhImasenapurogAshcha bhrAtaraH sarva eva te
shlokas.42:
antaHpureShu cha tadA sumahAnruditasvanaH |
prAdurAsInmahArAja pRRithAM shrutvA tathAgatAm
shlokas.43:
taM cha vRRiddhaM tathA dagdhaM hataputraM narAdhipam |
anvashochanta te sarve gAndhArIM cha tapasvinIm
shlokas.44:
tasminnuparate shabde muhUrtAdiva bhArata |
nigRRihya bAShpaM dhairyeNa dharmarAjo.abravIdidam

shlokas.1:
yudhiShThira uvAcha||
tathA mahAtmanastasya tapasyugre cha vartataH |
anAthasyeva nidhanaM tiShThatsvasmAsu bandhuShu
shlokas.2:
durvij~neyA hi gatayaH puruShANAM matA mama |
yatra vaichitravIryo.asau dagdha evaM davAgninA
shlokas.3:
yasya putrashataM shrImadabhavadbAhushAlinaH |
nAgAyutabalo rAjA sa dagdho hi davAgninA
shlokas.4:
yaM purA paryavIjanta tAlavRRintairvarastriyaH |
taM gRRidhrAH paryavIjanta dAvAgniparikAlitam
shlokas.5:
sUtamAgadhasa~Nghaishcha shayAno yaH prabodhyate |
dharaNyAM sa nRRipaH shete pApasya mama karmabhiH
shlokas.6:
na tu shochAmi gAndhArIM hataputrAM yashasvinIm |
patilokamanuprAptAM tathA bhartRRivrate sthitAm
shlokas.7:
pRRithAmeva tu shochAmi yA putraishvaryamRRiddhimat |
utsRRijya sumahaddIptaM vanavAsamarochayat
shlokas.8:
dhigrAjyamidamasmAkaM dhigbalaM dhikparAkramam |
kShatradharmaM cha dhigyasmAnmRRitA jIvAmahe vayam
shlokas.9:
susUkShmA kila kAlasya gatirdvijavarottama |
yatsamutsRRijya rAjyaM sA vanavAsamarochayat
shlokas.10:
yudhiShThirasya jananI bhImasya vijayasya cha |
anAthavatkathaM dagdhA iti muhyAmi chintayan
shlokas.11:
vRRithA santoShito vahniH khANDave savyasAchinA |
upakAramajAnansa kRRitaghna iti me matiH
shlokas.12:
yatrAdahatsa bhagavAnmAtaraM savyasAchinaH |
kRRitvA yo brAhmaNachChadma bhikShArthI samupAgataH
dhigagniM dhikcha pArthasya vishrutAM satyasandhatAm
shlokas.13:
idaM kaShTataraM chAnyadbhagavanpratibhAti me |
vRRithAgninA samAyogo yadabhUtpRRithivIpateH
shlokas.14:
tathA tapasvinastasya rAjarSheH kauravasya ha |
kathameva.nvidho mRRityuH prashAsya pRRithivImimAm
shlokas.15:
tiShThatsu mantrapUteShu tasyAgniShu mahAvane |
vRRithAgninA samAyukto niShThAM prAptaH pitA mama
shlokas.16:
manye pRRithA vepamAnA kRRishA dhamanisantatA |
hA tAta dharmarAjeti samAkrandanmahAbhaye
shlokas.17:
bhIma paryApnuhi bhayAditi chaivAbhivAshatI |
samantataH parikShiptA mAtA me.abhUddavAgninA
shlokas.18:
sahadevaH priyastasyAH putrebhyo.adhika eva tu |
na chainAM mokShayAmAsa vIro mAdravatIsutaH
shlokas.19:
tachChrutvA ruruduH sarve samAli~Ngya parasparam |
pANDavAH pa~ncha duHkhArtA bhUtAnIva yugakShaye
shlokas.20:
teShAM tu puruShendrANAM rudatAM ruditasvanaH |
prAsAdAbhogasa.nruddho anvarautsItsa rodasI

shlokas.1:
nArada uvAcha||
nAsau vRRithAgninA dagdho yathA tatra shrutaM mayA |
vaichitravIryo nRRipatistatte vakShyAmi bhArata
shlokas.2:
vanaM pravishatA tena vAyubhakSheNa dhImatA |
agnayaH kArayitveShTimutsRRiShTA iti naH shrutam
shlokas.3:
yAjakAstu tatastasya tAnagnInnirjane vane |
samutsRRijya yathAkAmaM jagmurbharatasattama
shlokas.4:
sa vivRRiddhastadA vahnirvane tasminnabhUtkila |
tena tadvanamAdIptamiti me tApasAbruvan
shlokas.5:
sa rAjA jAhnavIkachChe yathA te kathitaM mayA |
tenAgninA samAyuktaH svenaiva bharatarShabha
shlokas.6:
evamAvedayAmAsurmunayaste mamAnagha |
ye te bhAgIrathItIre mayA dRRiShTA yudhiShThira
shlokas.7:
evaM svenAgninA rAjA samAyukto mahIpate |
mA shochithAstvaM nRRipatiM gataH sa paramAM gatim
shlokas.8:
gurushushrUShayA chaiva jananI tava pANDava |
prAptA sumahatIM siddhimiti me nAtra sa.nshayaH
shlokas.9:
kartumarhasi kauravya teShAM tvamudakakriyAm |
bhrAtRRibhiH sahitaH sarvairetadatra vidhIyatAm
shlokas.10:
vaishampAyana uvAcha||
tataH sa pRRithivIpAlaH pANDavAnAM dhurandharaH |
niryayau saha sodaryaiH sadAro bharatarShabha
shlokas.11:
paurajAnapadAshchaiva rAjabhaktipuraskRRitAH |
ga~NgAM prajagmurabhito vAsasaikena sa.nvRRitAH
shlokas.12:
tato.avagAhya salilaM sarve te kurupu~NgavAH |
yuyutsumagrataH kRRitvA dadustoyaM mahAtmane
shlokas.13:
gAndhAryAshcha pRRithAyAshcha vidhivannAmagotrataH |
shauchaM nivartayantaste tatroShurnagarAdbahiH
shlokas.14:
preShayAmAsa sa narAnvidhij~nAnAptakAriNaH |
ga~NgAdvAraM kurushreShTho yatra dagdho.abhavannRRipaH
shlokas.15:
tatraiva teShAM kulyAni ga~NgAdvAre.anvashAttadA |
kartavyAnIti puruShAndattadeyAnmahIpatiH
shlokas.16:
dvAdashe.ahani tebhyaH sa kRRitashaucho narAdhipaH |
dadau shrAddhAni vidhivaddakShiNAvanti pANDavaH
shlokas.17:
dhRRitarAShTraM samuddishya dadau sa pRRithivIpatiH |
suvarNaM rajataM gAshcha shayyAshcha sumahAdhanAH
shlokas.18:
gAndhAryAshchaiva tejasvI pRRithAyAshcha pRRithakpRRithak |
sa~NkIrtya nAmanI rAjA dadau dAnamanuttamam
shlokas.19:
yo yadichChati yAvachcha tAvatsa labhate dvijaH |
shayanaM bhojanaM yAnaM maNiratnamatho dhanam
shlokas.20:
yAnamAchChAdanaM bhogAndAsIshcha parichArikAH |
dadau rAjA samuddishya tayormAtrormahIpatiH
shlokas.21:
tataH sa pRRithivIpAlo dattvA shrAddhAnyanekashaH |
pravivesha punardhImAnnagaraM vAraNAhvayam
shlokas.22:
te chApi rAjavachanAtpuruShA ye gatAbhavan |
sa~Nkalpya teShAM kulyAni punaH pratyAgama.nstataH
shlokas.23:
mAlyairgandhaishcha vividhaiH pUjayitvA yathAvidhi |
kulyAni teShAM sa.nyojya tadAchakhyurmahIpateH
shlokas.25:
evaM varShANyatItAni dhRRitarAShTrasya dhImataH |
vanavAse tadA trINi nagare dasha pa~ncha cha
shlokas.26:
hataputrasya sa~NgrAme dAnAni dadataH sadA |
j~nAtisambandhimitrANAM bhrAtR^INAM svajanasya cha
